zh_title: 我们对中国在台湾周边军事演习的了解
summary: 11 月 5 日，X 上的一篇帖子写道：“刚刚到来：中国接管台湾”，其中有一张动画地图，旨在显示对该岛正在进行的吞并。 “在过去的几个小时里，中国的飞机和海上巡逻队正在关闭对台湾的监视，现在更加明确并证实，任何进出台湾的行动现在都受到中国军事存在的控制，”它补充道。社交媒体用户声称，这段发布于 2026 年 11 月 5 日的视频记录了中国军队在台湾附近进行的演习。但实际上，它对美国的军事行动做出了错误的解释。
content:
11 月 5 日，X 上的一篇帖子写道：“刚刚到来：中国接管台湾”，其中有一张动画地图，旨在显示对该岛正在进行的吞并。 “在过去的几个小时里，中国的飞机和海上巡逻队正在关闭对台湾的监视，现在更加明确并证实，任何进出台湾的行动现在都受到中国军事存在的控制，”它补充道。

 社交媒体用户声称，这段发布于 2026 年 11 月 5 日的视频记录了中国军队在台湾附近进行的演习。然而，实际上，它对正在进行的军事行动提出了错误的解释。资料来源：X.

要显示来自 X (Twitter) 的此内容，您必须启用广告跟踪和受众测量。

动画地图显示，数十架飞机从[中国](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/china/)起飞，飞往[台湾](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/taiwan/)，包围该岛并将其与空中隔离。与此同时，中国海军的数十艘舰艇似乎也在台湾周围形成严密的封锁。其他船只似乎正在与两艘中国航母“福建”号和“辽宁”号并肩行驶。该地图在多个不同的 X 帖子中获得了超过 700,000 次浏览。

## **由可疑帐户共享的地图**

然而，这种对中国人民解放军演习的解读是有误导性的。
自11月2日以来，中国确实部署了重要的[军事](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/military/)手段。台湾国家安全委员会秘书长[Joseph Wu](https://x.com/josephwutw/status/2117592613905895766?a=Oe0s7ZBTG2fc-4vIjCk&s=20)， 11月3日报道称，中国海军和海警的100艘舰艇在西太平洋。与此同时，台北国防部当天报告称，在台湾附近发现了49架中国军用飞机。

然而，巴黎高等商学院地缘政治系副研究员伊曼纽尔·贝隆表示，这一部署并不意味着对台湾实施了封锁。 “这种说法绝对是错误的，”他说。 “这要么是[影响者](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/influencers/)的夸大其词，要么是中国的宣传声称‘就是这样’，中华人民共和国控制着台湾。”
共享这张地图的帐户之一 Fablex 的传记信息引起了我们的怀疑。虽然个人资料声称 Fablex 位于[加利福尼亚](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/california/)，但 X 帐户的信息显示它位于[乌干达](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/uganda/)。虽然使用VPN有可能改变账户的位置，但这条线索表明——连同对其他主题的其他帖子的分析，其中包括[爱泼斯坦事件](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261012-inside-jeffrey-epstein-s-network-how-favours-money-and-influence-kept-it-running)——它实际上只是一个点击诱饵帐户。这意味着它的目标是通过分享病毒式和耸人听闻的帖子来获得观点。

 Fablex 的账户关于其位置的信息相互矛盾。 © X

## **民用船只仍在台湾周围航行**

台湾国防部在[X](https://x.com/MoNDefense/status/2119595834820251735?a=h5MvRe3e6Or4tvEbnoo&s=20)上发布的一份报告中还表示，在11月8日至9日的24小时内，只有一架中国飞机被统计到台湾以北——比第49架飞机有所下降

【原文 English Original】
“Just in: China takes over Taiwan,” reads a post on X from November 5, featuring an animated map meant to show the ongoing annexation of the island. “In the past few hours, Chinese aircrafts and marine patrols were closing [sic] monitoring Taiwan and now its more clear and confirmed that any movements to and from Taiwan is now controlled by the Chinese military presence," it added.

 Social media users claimed this video, posted on November 5, 2026, documented Chinese army exercises carried out near Taiwan. However, in reality, it presents an erroneous interpretation of the military actions underway. Source: X.

To display this content from X (Twitter), you must enable advertisement tracking and audience measurement.

The animated map shows dozens of planes taking off from continental [China](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/china/) and flying towards [Taiwan](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/taiwan/), encircling the island and isolating it from the air. Meanwhile, dozens of ships from the Chinese navy also seem to be forming an airtight blockade, surrounding Taiwan. Other ships seem to be moving alongside two Chinese aircraft carriers, the Fujian and the Liaoning. The map garnered more than 700,000 views across several different X posts.

## **Map shared by a suspicious account**

However, this interpretation of the Chinese People’s Liberation Army’s manoeuvres is misleading.

China has indeed deployed significant [military](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/military/) means since November 2. [Joseph Wu](https://x.com/josephwutw/status/2117592613905895766?a=Oe0s7ZBTG2fc-4vIjCk&s=20), the secretary general of Taiwan’s National Security Council, reported on November 3 that 100 ships from the Chinese navy and coast guard were in the western Pacific. Meanwhile, Taipei's Ministry of National Defence reported the same day that 49 Chinese military aircraft had been detected near Taiwan.

However, this deployment does not mean a blockade has been implemented on Taiwan, says Emmanuel Véron, an associate researcher in the geopolitics department at HEC Paris. “This claim is absolutely false,” he said. “It’s either exaggerations made by [influencers](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/influencers/) or Chinese propaganda claiming ‘that’s it’, the People’s Republic of China controls Taiwan.”

Our suspicions were raised by the biographical information on one of the accounts that shared this map, Fablex. While the profile claims Fablex is located in [California](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/california/), the X account's information says it is based in [Uganda](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/uganda/). While it is possible that the location of an account can be altered with the use of a VPN, this clue suggests– along with an analysis of its other posts about, among other topics, [the Epstein affair](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261012-inside-jeffrey-epstein-s-network-how-favours-money-and-influence-kept-it-running)– that it is actually just a clickbait account. That means it aims to get views by sharing viral and sensationalist posts.

 Fablex’s account has contradictory information about its location. © X

## **Civilian ships still moving around Taiwan**

In a report posted on[X](https://x.com/MoNDefense/status/2119595834820251735?a=h5MvRe3e6Or4tvEbnoo&s=20), the Taiwanese Ministry of National Defence also said that during a 24-hour period between November 8 and 9, just one Chinese aircraft was counted north of Taiwan - a drop from the 49 flights recorded on November 3. On the same day, just eight Chinese ships were spotted near Taiwan. “Eight ships are just not enough to organise a blockade,” Véron says. “It is possible that we are seeing the winding down of these operations.”

According to[MarineTraffic](https://www.marinetraffic.com/en/ais/home/centerx:121.0/centery:23.7/zoom:8), civilian ships have continued to circulate Taiwan. The container ship One Hanoi, for example, left the Kaohsiung port in the south of Taiwan on November 3, during the height of the operations carried out by the People’s Liberation Army around Taiwan. The ship then entered the Taiwan Strait.

 The image above shows the marine traffic around Taiwan on November 3, 2026, which was the day when the highest number of flights by Chinese army aircraft around Taiwan was recorded. The image below shows the trajectory of the container ship One Hanoi on November 3. © MarineTraffic

## **‘Gigantic operation’ on several fronts**

What is China’s goal in carrying out these military manoeuvres? Unlike[last year's](https://www.france24.com/en/asia-pacific/20251229-china-conducts-large-scale-taiwan-drills-amid-rising-tensions) military drill, Chinese authorities didn’t announce the operations before they began, no doubt by design.

“The aim is to play with communication,” Véron says. “They might make an announcement after the exercises. They also might be trying to remain relatively discreet ahead of the next APEC summit [Editor’s note: Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation], which will be held in China [Editor’s note: on November 18].”

However, Véron does say that the extent of the Chinese military operations underway is unprecedented:

> “For several days now, we’ve seen a gigantic naval operation underway. The different branches of the army are participating, but the naval contingent is actually huge and involves the mobilisation of about a hundred ships from the Chinese navy as well as the Coast Guard and even auxiliary fishing ships across different fronts. And in that, we are seeing a kind of first.”
>
>
> Up until now, the large military exercises aimed at putting pressure on Taiwan largely took place on the side of the island facing China. Now we are seeing operations take place in the north, the south and the centre.”

A map shared by the [Institute for the Study of War](https://understandingwar.org/research/china-taiwan/china-taiwan-update-november-3-2026/), a research organisation based in the United States, showed that on November 3, the Chinese navy was not just deployed around Taiwan but also in the South China Sea, the East China Sea and the Philippine Sea.

 This map shows the deployment of the Chinese navy on November 3. Source: the Institute for the Study of War (ISW)

To display this content from X (Twitter), you must enable advertisement tracking and audience measurement.

## **Simulation, not an invasion**

The size of the operations underway does not indicate an imminent invasion of Taiwan, says Véron:

> “We are not going to wake up tomorrow to an operation where Taiwan is being taken by force. This is a ‘drill’, as soldiers say, a training exercise carried out in real geographic and operational conditions. The aim is to simulate a real military operation to train, to test and to exert pressure on the Taiwanese government and Taiwan’s allies. It’s a continuation of the pressure that China has long put on Taiwan.”

• 王毅表示，中方愿同韩方进一步增进互信，扩大共同利益
• 下周，韩国总统李在明将访华并出席在深圳举行的亚太经合组织（APEC）领导人会议 路透社

China's top diplomat calls for expanding cooperation in meeting with South Korean minister

Published Nov 13, 2026, 11:19 PM
Updated Nov 13, 2026, 11:19 PM
BEIJING, Nov 13 - China is willing to expand cooperation with South Korea in traditional and emerging sectors including artificial intelligence and biomedicine, Foreign Minister Wang Yi said on Friday.
• In a meeting with his South Korean counterpart Cho Hyun, Wang said the two countries are "close neighbours that cannot be moved away" and "maintaining good-neighbourliness and friendship is the right choice for both sides," according to a statement released by China's Foreign Ministry
• The South Korean diplomat is on a two-day visit to China starting Friday
• China-South Korea relations were "back onto the right track" after their leaders' exchanges since late last year, Wang said
• Ties soured under Yoon Suk Yeol, the predecessor of South Korean President Lee Jae Myung, who drew Seoul closer to Washington and Tokyo
• Lee, who took office in June 2025, has sought to restore relations, hosting Chinese President Xi Jinping in Gyeongju in late 2025 and making a state visit to China in January
• China is willing to further enhance mutual trust with South Korea and expand their common interests, Wang said
• Next week, South Korean President Lee Jae Myung will visit China and attend the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) leaders' meeting in Shenzhen REUTERS

content:
黄仁勋的倒台会削弱中国的人工智能雄心吗？ |海峡时报
黄仁勋的倒台会削弱中国的人工智能雄心吗？
立即注册：深入了解亚洲的快速发展
英伟达前首席执行官黄仁勋五月份在北京向媒体发表讲话，他因成为外国情报机构的目标而受到调查。
发表于 2026 年 11 月 13 日晚上 10:05
更新于 2026 年 11 月 13 日 10:05
黄仁勋在英伟达的辞职引发了人们的担忧，即美国可能会收紧芯片控制，威胁中国获得先进人工智能计算的机会。
中国称这些间谍指控“毫无根据”，并表示美国正在利用这些指控作为对中国“技术封锁”的借口。
分析师表示，短期内中国人工智能企业面临的压力可能会增加，但这种冲击也可能会加速国内芯片的发展。
北京 — — 英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋突然辞职引发了有关中国获取美国先进人工智能芯片的新问题，北京指责华盛顿利用间谍指控为更严格的技术限制辩护，尽管中国分析人士淡化了潜在影响。
黄仁勋曾亲自游说美国总统唐纳德·特朗普放宽对中国芯片销售的限制，他是保持美国技术流向世界第二大经济体的最直言不讳的倡导者之一。
在美国立法者敦促对中国获取先进计算能力进行更严格控制之际，他的离开可能会削弱华盛顿的这种声音，这可能会增加北京推动半导体自给自足的紧迫性。
中国分析师表示，后果可能是双向的——进一步的限制可能会在短期内限制中国人工智能开发商，同时加强对国内替代品的推动，并为华为等中国芯片制造商创造机会。
黄先生于 11 月 12 日辞职，此前他的婚外情被曝光，其中包括一名被美国官员指控与中国情报部门有联系的中国女性。这标志着他 33 年任期的结束，在此期间，他将 Nvidia 打造成全球领先的人工智能芯片供应商。
他长期以来一直认为，将中国排除在美国芯片技术之外会适得其反，会剥夺美国公司的收入，同时鼓励中国竞争对手开发自己的替代品。
自从黄与一名所谓的中国间谍有牵连的消息传出后，中国外交部一再否认这些间谍指控，称这些指控“毫无根据”，是对中国的“抹黑”。美国官员尚未提供证据证明他们的说法。
在11月12日的例行记者会上，中国外交部发言人毛宁表示，美国“应该停止编造中国间谍故事作为实施技术封锁的借口”，并补充说，中国的技术进步是由自主创新和开放合作驱动的。
中国官方媒体《环球时报》也批评了其所称的对美国科技公司日益增长的政治干预，认为黄的离职反映出越来越多地利用国家安全担忧来限制涉及中国的商业决策。
复旦大学美国研究中心主任吴心伯淡化了这对中国人工智能雄心的潜在影响，他表示，中国已经致力于发展自己的半导体能力，无论华盛顿是否

Would Jensen Huang’s fall dent China’s AI ambitions? | The Straits Times
Would Jensen Huang’s fall dent China’s AI ambitions?
Sign up now: Get insights on Asia's fast-moving developments
Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, seen here addressing media in Beijing in May, is being investigated for being the target of a foreign intelligence operation.
Published Nov 13, 2026, 10:05 PM
Updated Nov 13, 2026, 10:05 PM
Jensen Huang’s resignation at Nvidia has raised fears that the US may tighten chip controls, threatening China’s access to advanced AI computing.
China called the spy claims “purely unsubstantiated” and said the US is using them as a pretext for “technology blockades” against China.
Analysts said pressure on Chinese AI firms may grow in the short term, but the shock could also speed up domestic chip development.
BEIJING – The abrupt resignation of Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang has raised fresh questions about China’s access to advanced American artificial intelligence chips, with Beijing accusing Washington of using espionage allegations to justify tighter technology restrictions even as Chinese analysts play down the potential fallout.
Huang, who personally lobbied US President Donald Trump to ease restrictions on chip sales to China, was among the most vocal advocates for keeping American technology flowing to the world’s second-largest economy.
His departure now threatens to weaken that voice in Washington at a time when US lawmakers are pressing for stricter controls on China’s access to advanced computing power, potentially adding urgency to Beijing’s push for semiconductor self-sufficiency.
Chinese analysts said the consequences could cut both ways – further restrictions may constrain Chinese AI developers in the short term, while strengthening the push for domestic alternatives and creating opportunities for Chinese chipmakers such as Huawei.
Huang’s Nov 12 resignation followed revelations of extramarital affairs, including one involving a Chinese woman alleged by US officials to have links to Chinese intelligence. It marked the end of his 33-year tenure during which he built Nvidia into the world’s leading supplier of the chips that power AI.
He had long argued that excluding China from American chip technology would be counterproductive and would deprive US companies of revenue while encouraging Chinese competitors to develop their own alternatives.
Since news of Huang’s involvement with an alleged Chinese spy broke, China’s Foreign Ministry has repeatedly rejected the espionage allegations, calling them “purely unsubstantiated” and “smears” against China. US officials have not provided evidence for their claims.
At a regular press briefing on Nov 12, Chinese Foreign Ministry spokeswoman Mao Ning said the US “should stop fabricating the Chinese spy narratives as a pretext for imposing technology blockades,” adding that China’s technological progress is driven by independent innovation and open cooperation.
Chinese state media Global Times also criticised what it described as growing political interference in American technology companies, arguing that Huang’s departure reflected the increasing use of national security concerns to constrain commercial decisions involving China.
Wu Xinbo, director of Fudan University’s Centre for American Studies, played down the potential impact on China’s AI ambitions, saying that China was already committed to developing its own semiconductor capabilities, regardless of whether Washington relaxed or tightened its restrictions.
He pointed to competing views within China over whether to continue purchasing American chips, which still offered performance advantages, or concentrate on developing domestic alternatives.
“If the US tightens its restrictions on chip export controls, which seems likely, it would strengthen the latter camp and benefit Chinese chipmakers,” said Wu, who advises China’s Foreign Ministry.
“The message sent is that the US cannot be relied upon, it can tighten restrictions at any time so we still have to depend on ourselves.”
More fundamentally, Wu said that China and the US were increasingly competing on different fronts. The US is more focused on producing the most advanced AI models, chips and computing capabilities, while Beijing places greater emphasis on commercialising AI and integrating it into manufacturing, healthcare and everyday life.
Zhu Feng, dean of the School of International Studies at Nanjing University, told ST that greater determination to develop domestic alternatives would not immediately close the technological gap.
No impact on chip supply, partnerships amid resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang: Singtel
Why is Nvidia king of the AI chip hill and how soon can rivals catch up?
While tighter restrictions could accelerate investment in domestic alternatives, they would not immediately eliminate China’s dependence on foreign chips, he said. This is because China would not be able to match the capabilities of leading companies such as Nvidia, Taiwan’s TSMC and South Korea’s SK Hynix in the short term, he added.
“Pressure on China will certainly increase in the short term, but in the medium to long term, much depends on whether China can keep its composure and achieve further technological breakthroughs of its own,” he said.
Since 2022, the US government has barred Nvidia from selling its most advanced chips to China. However, in 2025, Trump allowed Nvidia to sell H20 chips to China on a case-by-case basis, and later extended it to Nvidia’s H200 chips.
On Nov 13, shares of Chinese tech companies such as Alibaba, Tencent and Z.ai took a hit as Nvidia’s leadership crisis raised fears that Washington could further tighten restrictions on China’s access to advanced AI computing.
Although Washington restricts direct exports of Nvidia’s top AI chips to China, Chinese companies are still able to rent such advanced computing power from overseas data centres.
In a commentary published on Nov 13 after Huang’s resignation, Global Times warned that other technology executives could face similar scrutiny if their business interests conflicted with Washington’s political agenda.
It also argued that Huang’s Chinese heritage and his calls for continued chip exports had made him particularly vulnerable to political suspicion.
What is Super Micro, the firm named in Singapore’s AI chips probe?
Malaysia says it is working with S’pore, US to curb chip smuggling as AI sector braces itself for impact
Nanjing University’s Zhu warned that the allegations could fuel a new wave of anti-Chinese sentiment in American political and business circles.
He said the controversy could accelerate efforts by some in Washington to sever technological ties with China, extending beyond chip export controls to broader restrictions on cooperation at a time when advances in AI require both competition and dialogue.
“Whether this will lead to a new Cold War in the field of AI remains to be seen,” he said.
Michelle Ng is China correspondent at The Straits Times. She is interested in Chinese foreign policies, property trends, demographics, education and rural issues.

流亡柬埔寨政客以镇压为由谴责法语国家峰会海峡时报
流亡柬埔寨政客谴责法语国家峰会，称镇压
立即注册：深入了解亚洲的快速发展
发表于 2026 年 11 月 13 日，晚上 08:04
更新于 2026 年 11 月 13 日 08:04 PM
曼谷，11月13日 - 流亡的柬埔寨反对派人士桑兰西谴责包括法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙在内的领导人本周末在金边举行的聚会是“骗局”，称这个东南亚国家的政治迫害和有组织犯罪使其成为不合适的场所。
国家元首和高级部长正在柬埔寨首都举行法语国家国际组织（OIF）峰会。该组织促进法语国家之间的合作，并将和平、民主和人权列为其核心原则。
“我认为峰会将在错误的时间、错误的地点举行，”兰西周五在巴黎通过电话告诉路透社。他逃离柬埔寨后过着自我流放的生活，在柬埔寨他被缺席定罪多项罪行，他的政党也被取缔。
“柬埔寨在民主、法治、人权、司法独立方面处于非常困难的境地……这完全违背了法语国家应代表的价值观，”他说。 “我认为这是一场骗局。这是一次奇怪的峰会。”
柬埔寨新闻部长内斯·菲克特拉 (Neth Pheaktra) 表示，政府“没有时间争论”，专注于使这次会议取得成功。
周一，联合国驻柬埔寨人权特使汤姆·安德鲁斯敦促政府在峰会前释放 100 多名因“行使基本自由”而被拘留的人，其中包括环保活动人士。他表示，这样做将尊重 OIF 的价值观。
由 26 个柬埔寨组织组成的联盟本周向加拿大和法国驻金边大使馆提交了一份联合请愿书，理由是“民主倒退、侵犯人权和对公民社会的攻击”。它呼吁参加峰会的国家抗议“迅速恶化的局势”。
爱丽舍宫的一名官员告诉路透社，法国在峰会上“要传达信息”，人权和法治问题正在“各个层面”得到解决。
这位官员表示：“空席政策并不是推动这些问题取得进展的最佳方式。”
强人洪森统治柬埔寨近四十年，直到 2023 年将权力移交给他的儿子洪马内。他保留了相当大的影响力，包括作为执政的柬埔寨人民党的领导人。
人权组织表示，政治镇压仍在继续，政府压制异见人士、独立媒体和民间社会。
柬埔寨也已成为价值数十亿美元的网络欺诈行业的中心，犯罪集团（主要是华人）建立了庞大的诈骗场所，由被贩运的工人组成，被迫诈骗世界各地的人们。政府去年发起了打击行动，但批评人士表示，它未能针对与该行业相关的有权势精英。
另一位流亡柬埔寨政治家穆索楚亚表示：“当犯罪网络逍遥法外、公民的民主权利被剥夺时，法语国家就无法可信地促进共同繁荣。”路透社

Exiled Cambodian politician denounces Francophonie summit, citing repression
Sign up now: Get insights on Asia's fast-moving developments
Published Nov 13, 2026, 08:04 PM
Updated Nov 13, 2026, 08:04 PM
BANGKOK, Nov 13 - Exiled Cambodian opposition figure Sam Rainsy denounced a gathering of leaders, including French President Emmanuel Macron, in Phnom Penh this weekend as a "sham", saying political persecution and organised crime in the Southeast Asian nation made it an inappropriate venue.
Heads of state and senior ministers are meeting in the Cambodian capital for a summit of the International Organisation of La Francophonie (OIF). The organisation promotes cooperation between French-speaking nations and lists peace, democracy and human rights among its core tenets.
"I think the summit is going to take place at the wrong place at the wrong time," Rainsy told Reuters on Friday by phone from Paris. He lives in self-exile after fleeing Cambodia, where he has been convicted of multiple offences in absentia and his political party has been banned.
"Cambodia is in a very difficult situation in terms of democracy, the rule of law, human rights, independence of the judiciary...which is totally contrary to the values that the Francophonie is supposed to represent," he said. "I think it is a sham. It is a strange summit."
Neth Pheaktra, Cambodia's minister of information, said the government had "no time for polemics" and was focused on making the gathering a success.
On Monday, Tom Andrews, the United Nations' human rights envoy to Cambodia, urged the government to release more than 100 people detained for "exercising their fundamental freedoms", including environmental activists, before the summit. He said doing so would honor the OIF's values.
A coalition of 26 Cambodian organisations this week handed the Canadian and French embassies in Phnom Penh a joint petition citing "democratic backsliding, human rights violations, and attacks on civil society". It called on states attending the summit to protest the "rapidly deteriorating situation".
An Elysee official told Reuters that France had "messages to convey" at the summit and that human rights and rule of law were being addressed "at all levels".
"The policy of the empty chair is not the best way to move these issues forward," the official said.
Strongman Hun Sen governed Cambodia for nearly four decades until 2023, when he handed power to his son, Hun Manet. He retains considerable influence, including as head of the ruling Cambodian People's Party.
Rights groups say political repression has continued, with the government stifling dissent, independent media and civil society.
Cambodia has also become an epicenter of the multibillion-dollar cyberfraud industry, as criminal syndicates, mostly of Chinese origin, have built sprawling scam compounds staffed by trafficked workers forced to defraud people worldwide. The government launched a crackdown last year, but critics say it has failed to target powerful elites linked to the industry.
“The Francophonie cannot credibly promote shared prosperity while criminal networks operate with impunity and citizens are denied their democratic rights,” said Mu Sochua, another exiled Cambodian politician. REUTERS

content:
日本尚未充分利用与印度的核电设备出口条约 - 日本时报
日本尚未充分利用与印度的核电设备出口条约
2016 年 11 月，日本首相安倍晋三（右）和印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪（左二）在东京举行的日本与印度和平利用核能合作条约签字仪式上。 |集集
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads 电子邮件 打印 书签故事 复制链接
新德里 — — 自十年前两国签署和平利用核能合作条约以来，日本向印度出口核电站设备方面尚未取得具体进展。
尽管印度已经建立了法律框架，使外国公司更容易向该国供应核电站，因为政府寻求扩大核电站的装机容量或最大潜在电力输出。
该条约于2016年11月签署，并于2017年7月生效，允许日本出口核电技术和设备。印度的核责任法是阻碍日本核电站出口的因素之一。
该法律规定，不仅核电站运营商，而且设备供应商也要对核事故造成的损害承担责任。该规定阻碍了公司进入该行业。
去年12月，印度制定了一项法律，允许设备供应商避免承担责任，除非他们通过合同协议明确承担责任。该法律还部分允许包括外国公司在内的公司建造和运营核电站。
“出口机会可能会扩大，包括通过与外国制造商合作，”行业组织日本原子工业论坛的一位官员表示。该组织表示，日本公司有向美国制造的核电站供应设备的记录。
目前，印度有24座核反应堆在运行，总装机容量约为8.78吉瓦。纳伦德拉·莫迪总理政府的目标是到 2047 年印度独立 100 周年时将装机容量提高到 100 吉瓦。
莫迪政府还计划到 2070 年将温室气体排放量减少到净零。
印度海得拉巴市沃克森大学副教授达亚·香卡 (Daya Shankar) 表示：“运行中温室气体排放量可以忽略不计的核电对于这条道路是不可或缺的。”
该核合作条约在签署时在日本国内引起了争议，因为这意味着日本这个唯一遭受原子武器袭击的国家将被允许向印度这个非《核不扩散条约》成员国的核国家出口核电站。
香卡表示，2011 年福岛县核事故发生后，“日本国内政治中的反核情绪依然强烈”。他补充说，任何“向非《不扩散核武器条约》签署国出口核技术的举动都会招致国内的尖锐批评”。
环保主义者E.A.S.反对日印条约的前印度政府官员萨尔马表示，“请思考一下核电站会给当地社区的生活造成的破坏，以及当核电站发生时，它如何使大片人口稠密的地区遭受类似福岛灾难的祸害。”

Japan yet to make full use of nuclear power equipment export treaty with India - The Japan Times
Japan yet to make full use of nuclear power equipment export treaty with India
Prime Minister Shinzo Abe (right) and India's Prime Minister Narendra Modi (second from left) at a signing ceremony for a treaty of cooperation in the peaceful use of nuclear energy between Japan and India, during November 2016 in Tokyo. | JIJI
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads Email Print Bookmark story Copy link
New Delhi – No concrete progress has been made in exporting nuclear power plant equipment from Japan to India since the two countries signed a treaty of cooperation in the peaceful use of nuclear energy a decade ago.
This is despite India having established a legal framework that made it easier for foreign firms to supply nuclear plants to the country as the government seeks to expand the installed capacity, or the maximum potential output of electricity, of nuclear plants.
The treaty, which allows Japan to export nuclear power technology and equipment, was signed in November 2016 and took effect in July 2017. One of the factors hindering Japan’s nuclear power plant exports had been India’s nuclear liability law.
The law stipulated that not only plant operators but also equipment suppliers would be held liable for damage from nuclear accidents. The provision discouraged companies from entering the business.
In December last year, India established a law that allows equipment vendors to avoid liability unless they explicitly assume it through contractual agreements. The law also partially allows companies, including foreign firms, to build and operate nuclear power plants.
“Export opportunities may expand, including through collaboration with foreign manufacturers,” said an official at Japan Atomic Industrial Forum, an industry group. The group said that Japanese firms have a track record of supplying equipment to U.S.-made nuclear power plants.
Currently, 24 nuclear reactors are in operation in India, with a total installed capacity of approximately 8.78 gigawatts. The administration of Prime Minister Narendra Modi has a goal of boosting that capacity to 100 gigawatts by 2047, when India marks its 100th year of independence.
The Modi administration also aims to reduce greenhouse gas emissions to net zero by 2070.
“Nuclear power, with negligible operational greenhouse gas emissions, is indispensable to that pathway,” said Daya Shankar, associate professor at Woxsen University in the Indian city of Hyderabad.
The nuclear cooperation treaty caused a controversy in Japan at the time of its signing because this meant that Japan, the only country hit by atomic weapons, would be allowed to export nuclear plants to India, a nuclear state that is not a member of the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty (NPT).
“Antinuclear sentiment remains strong within Japan’s domestic politics” following the 2011 nuclear accident in Fukushima Prefecture, Shankar said. Any “move to export nuclear technology to a non-NPT signatory invited sharp domestic criticism,” he added.
Environmentalist E.A.S. Sarma, a former Indian government official who opposed the Japan-India treaty, said, “Please ponder over the disruption that a nuclear power plant will cause in the lives of the local communities and how it exposes vast stretches of thickly populated areas to the scourge of a Fukushima-like disaster, as and when it happens.”

content:
2026 年 11 月 13 日

日本横须贺——

由军事海运司令部运营的远征快速运输舰俾斯麦市号（EPF 9）迎来了新任指挥官，中校。蒂亚·迈尔斯在横须贺舰队活动船上举行的仪式上。迈尔斯从中校手中接过指挥权。 VanAnh McCormick，在将该船移交给 MILCREW II 之前担任军事船员 I 的指挥官。

“从我们的人员流动开始，我们不再是 MILCREW II 和 CIVMAR；我们都是俾斯麦市号航空母舰，”迈尔斯在向由水手和公务员组成的混合船员发表的讲话中说道。 “‘保持媒体报道’是我们的全部工作！我们必须在场并准备好参与，同时互相支持，以确保我们的成功。Crew I 奠定了基础，我们的工作就是在此基础上继续发展。Possumus Efficiemus：我们可以而且我们将会实现。”

迈尔斯是南卡罗来纳州哥伦比亚人，2014 年从弗朗西斯马里恩大学毕业并获得数学学士学位后，被任命为海军军官。她还拥有海军研究生院的高级工商管理硕士学位。

在海上，迈尔斯曾在阿利伯克号航空母舰 (DDG 51)、珍珠港号航空母舰 (LSD 52) 和哈珀斯渡口号航空母舰 (LSD 49) 上服役。
在岸上，她在圣地亚哥海军水面和水雷作战发展中心和水面高级作战学校担任两栖作战战术教员。迈尔斯接替了麦考密克，麦考密克于 2026 年 7 月接管了 MILCREW I 的指挥权，并带领船员完成了有史以来的首次 EPF 部署。部署期间，船员航行超过4000海里，访问了4个海外港口。机组人员为“锐剑”演习提供了后勤保障，并完成了任务要求的所有准备工作。此外，供应部门还入围了 David M. Cook 食品服务卓越奖的决赛。

俾斯麦号是EPF级第九艘舰艇。这些浅吃水、全铝制商用双体船旨在以 35 节的平均速度将 600 短吨军用货物运输 1,200 海里。该船设有用于直升机操作的飞行甲板、车辆卸载坡道部署以及增强沿海操作和港口通道的浅吃水。这些能力使 EPF 能够在严峻或受损的港口提供灵活的物流支持、快速运输和救灾。

该船的船员由军事人员和文职海员组成。 MILCREW 轮流部署，基地设在圣地亚哥，而该舰的母港是横须贺，由美国第七舰队负责作战控制。
军事海运司令部负责指挥和支持大约 140 艘民用船只的行动，这些船只为美国海军舰船补充海上补给、执行专门任务、在全球范围内预置战斗货物、提供支持服务以及向部署的美国部队运输军事装备和补给品。

【原文 English Original】
13 November 2026

YOKOSUKA, Japan --

The expeditionary fast transport USS City of Bismarck (EPF 9), operated by Military Sealift Command, welcomed its new commanding officer, Lt. Cmdr. Tia Myers, during a ceremony aboard the ship at Fleet Activities Yokosuka. Myers assumed command from Lt. Cmdr. VanAnh McCormick, who served as the Military Crew I commander before turning the ship over to MILCREW II.

“Starting with our turnover, we are no longer MILCREW II and CIVMARs; we are all USS City of Bismarck,” Myers said in her address to the hybrid crew of sailors and civil service mariners. “It is all of our job to ‘keep the press!’ We have to be present and ready to engage while supporting each other to ensure our success. Crew I laid the foundation, and it is our job to build upon it. Possumus Efficiemus: We can and we will accomplish.”

A native of Columbia, South Carolina, Myers commissioned as a naval officer in 2014 after graduating from Francis Marion University with a bachelor’s degree in mathematics. She also holds an executive master’s degree in business administration from the Naval Postgraduate School.

At sea, Myers served aboard USS Arleigh Burke (DDG 51), USS Pearl Harbor (LSD 52) and USS Harpers Ferry (LSD 49).

Ashore, she served as an amphibious warfare tactics instructor at the Naval Surface and Mine Warfighting Development Center and Surface Advanced Warfighting School in San Diego. Myers relieved McCormick, who took command of MILCREW I in July 2026 and led the crew through its first ever EPF deployment. During the deployment, the crew sailed more than 4,000 nautical miles and visited four overseas ports. The crew provided logistics support for Exercise Keen Sword and completed all ready for tasking requirements. In addition, the supply department became a finalist for the David M. Cook Food Service Excellence Award.

Bismarck is the ninth ship in the EPF class. These shallow-draft, all-aluminum, commercial-based catamarans are designed to transport 600 short tons of military cargo 1,200 nautical miles at an average speed of 35 knots. The ship features a flight deck for helicopter operations, a vehicle offload ramp deployment, and a shallow draft that enhances littoral operations and port access. These capabilities allow the EPF to deliver flexible logistics support, rapid transport and disaster relief in austere or damaged ports.

The ship operates with a hybrid crew of military personnel and civil service mariners. The MILCREWs rotate for deployments and are based in San Diego, while the ship is homeported in Yokosuka under the operational control of U.S. 7th Fleet.

Military Sealift Command directs and supports operations for approximately 140 civilian-crewed ships that replenish U.S. Navy ships at sea, conduct specialized missions, preposition combat cargo worldwide, provide support services, and transport military equipment and supplies to deployed U.S. forces.

Chinese v American Views on WAR with Taiwan
Posted Aug 14, 2026 by Martin Armstrong |
The Center for Strategic and International Studies conducted an extraordinary survey of 64 leading experts on China, Taiwan, and cross-Strait relations, including 28 former senior U.S. government officials, 23 former government policy and intelligence analysts, and 13 academics and think-tank experts. What their answers reveal is not that China is preparing to invade Taiwan tomorrow, as the neocons would like everyone to believe, but that Beijing remains willing to wait so long as nobody crosses the line of formal Taiwanese independence. Some 84% said Beijing is willing to wait for unification but will not accept the status quo permanently, while only 10% believed China seeks unification at the earliest opportunity. Not one of the 64 experts believed Beijing would ever accept an independent Taiwan.
This is precisely why Taiwan has become so dangerous. The West keeps portraying the conflict as if Xi Jinping wakes up every morning staring at a calendar trying to decide when to launch an amphibious invasion. Yet 83% of these experts said China did not plan to use significant kinetic force against Taiwan by 2027, and 80% said China’s enormous 2022 military exercises did not indicate Beijing had accelerated its timetable. Only 6% of respondents outside the former senior government group saw 2027 as a hard deadline, while not one former senior U.S. official did. The obsession with 2027 has nevertheless become extremely useful for the military establishment because every supposed deadline becomes another justification for weapons, deployments, bases, and spending.
The survey found that 44% believed Beijing has a hard deadline of 2049, the centennial of the People’s Republic, while 42% believed China could wait indefinitely provided unification remains possible. This is an important distinction because China thinks in terms of generations while Western politicians think in terms of the next election. Beijing does not need to invade Taiwan if economic, political, and military pressure can gradually change the situation in its favor. Only 20% of those surveyed believed China even possessed a coherent roadmap for peaceful unification, which tells us this is not some perfectly scripted invasion plan sitting in Xi’s desk drawer.
Where the numbers become alarming is not an unprovoked invasion but what happens when politicians begin crossing China’s red lines. More than three-quarters of the experts, 77%, believed China would invade within six months if Taiwan formally declared independence. Among former senior U.S. officials, that number was 79%. Even some of those who did not expect an immediate invasion believed Beijing would respond with a blockade or enormous military exercises. This is why politicians encouraging Taiwan toward formal independence are playing with the lives of 23 million people. They can deliver all the speeches they want about democracy from Washington, London, or Brussels, but they will not be the civilians sitting underneath the missiles if their political experiment goes wrong.
Not one expert believed an explicit American commitment to defend Taiwan would cause China to invade immediately, but 64% believed Beijing would respond strongly enough to provoke a U.S.-China or China-Taiwan crisis, while another 31% expected a more limited negative response. Only two of the 64 experts believed formally committing America to Taiwan’s defense would actually deter China from using force because Beijing already assumes that the United States will intervene anyway.
A direct invasion is not even the most likely path toward conflict. Only 8% of the experts described an amphibious invasion within ten years as likely, while 63% called it possible and 27% unlikely. Force short of invasion received much higher probabilities, with 52% saying deliberate escalation such as a blockade was likely or very likely. An accidental military incident was considered even more dangerous, with 34% saying a collision or accident around the Taiwan Strait was likely and another 22% calling it very likely. When warships and aircraft from opposing nuclear powers continually operate around the same small body of water, war does not require some grand master plan. It requires one mistake followed by politicians who refuse to back down.
A later CSIS survey of American and Taiwanese experts reinforces that point. Roughly 90% of U.S. experts and 62% of Taiwanese experts believed China already possessed the capability to impose a law-enforcement-led quarantine that substantially reduces trade into Taiwan. Around 80% of American experts and 60% of Taiwanese experts believed Beijing could execute a PLA blockade, while Taiwanese experts were considerably more skeptical that China could successfully carry out an invasion. If Beijing wanted to coerce Taiwan during the following five years, experts considered a quarantine the most likely option. If China decided it wanted immediate unification, however, approximately 80% regarded a highly kinetic joint blockade as likely or very likely.
This is where the economic consequences become enormous because Taiwan does not need to be invaded for the world economy to be thrown into chaos. A quarantine or blockade would immediately threaten shipping, insurance, semiconductor supply chains, electronics, automobiles, communications equipment, and virtually every modern industry dependent upon advanced chips. The later CSIS survey found most American and Taiwanese experts did not believe Taiwan could withstand a Chinese blockade for longer than three months without substantial U.S. intervention. Washington would then face the decision nobody wants to discuss honestly: accept China’s blockade or attempt to break it militarily and risk direct war between two nuclear powers.
Taiwan is also the world’s semiconductor pressure point. The island’s importance to advanced chip manufacturing means a serious blockade would not remain a regional event. Factories thousands of miles away could discover that a conflict they thought had nothing to do with them suddenly prevents them from obtaining critical components. Markets would begin repricing the risk immediately, shipping premiums would explode, companies would scramble for inventory, and governments would discover once again how fragile global supply chains have become. This is why capital will react long before politicians formally declare that a war has begun.
What I find particularly revealing in the later CSIS survey is the difference between American confidence and Taiwanese confidence in Washington. An astonishing 96% of American experts were completely or moderately confident that the United States would intervene militarily if China invaded Taiwan during the following five years. Taiwanese experts were less confident in American intervention and considerably less confident that U.S. allies would join the fight. It is always easier for people thousands of miles away to be certain about somebody else’s war.
This is precisely why Taiwan remains one of the critical geopolitical pressure points as we move toward 2029. The danger is not simply that China arbitrarily decides to invade. The greater danger is escalation, miscalculation, political promises that cannot be withdrawn, and Western policymakers convincing themselves that every additional provocation somehow produces deterrence. China has made its position on formal independence perfectly clear, and even the experts inside the Western foreign-policy establishment overwhelmingly acknowledge that Beijing would react with force if that line were crossed.
If Taiwan declares formal independence, 77% of the experts surveyed believed China would invade within six months. That is not a statistic policymakers should treat as another war-game scenario. It is a warning about what happens when politicians deliberately remove the ambiguity that has helped keep the peace.

summary: 特朗普、习近平、普京将举行中国峰会海峡时报 特朗普、习近平、普京将在中国举行历史性会晤：白宫 立即报名：洞察亚洲快速发展 俄罗斯艺术家阿列克谢·谢尔吉延科 (Alexey Sergienko) 描绘美国总统唐纳德·特朗普、俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京和中国国家主席习近平的新波普艺术画作《深圳 26》于 11 月 12 日在俄罗斯圣彼得堡揭幕。 发布于 2026 年 11 月 14 日上午 05:39 2026 年 11 月 14 日上午 09:41 更新 特朗普、习近平和普京将在深圳举行美俄中首次三方会晤
content:
特朗普、习近平、普京将举行中国峰会海峡时报
特朗普、习近平、普京将在中国举行历史性会晤：白宫
立即注册：深入了解亚洲的快速发展
俄罗斯艺术家阿列克谢·谢尔吉延科 (Alexey Sergienko) 描绘美国总统唐纳德·特朗普、俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京和中国国家主席习近平的新波普艺术画作《深圳 26》于 11 月 12 日在俄罗斯圣彼得堡揭幕。
发表于 2026 年 11 月 14 日 05:39
更新于 2026 年 11 月 14 日 09:41
特朗普、习近平和普京将于 11 月 19 日在深圳峰会上举行美俄中首次三方会晤。
特朗普计划讨论削减核武器和伊朗问题，但美国官员表示，不会提出乌克兰问题，因为该问题正在与基辅和莫斯科在另一条轨道上处理。
特朗普还将与习近平会面，共进双边午餐，而埃隆·马斯克将与他同行，但不会参加会谈；芯片出口管制和英伟达丑闻预计不会出现。
华盛顿 - 白宫 11 月 13 日表示，唐纳德·特朗普、弗拉基米尔·普京和习近平将于下周在深圳举行的峰会上举行美国、俄罗斯和中国领导人之间的首次三方会晤。
美国官员表示，特朗普希望在 11 月 19 日的三边会谈中讨论削减核武库的问题，并且还将提及他在伊朗的战争，但预计他不会讨论俄罗斯在乌克兰的战争。
白宫发言人奥利维亚·威尔士告诉记者，三位领导人将在中国南方城市亚太经合组织峰会期间会面。
“总统已明确表示，除其他议题外，他将讨论世界范围内核武器的削减。特朗普总统认为，这种扩散非常危险，”威尔士说。
美国官员表示，主导特朗普第二个总统任期的主要冲突之一将成为焦点，但另一个则不会。
一位不愿透露姓名的美国高级官员在电话中对记者表示：“我认为总统确实打算在与习近平和普京的三边会议上讨论伊朗问题。”
这位官员补充说，华盛顿正在与基辅和莫斯科进行“完全不同的谈判”，旨在结束乌克兰战争，他指的是美国特使最近几天与普京和乌克兰总统泽伦斯基进行的会谈。
这位官员补充道：“中国实际上并不是该轨道的一部分，因此在那里进行乌克兰问题的讨论似乎并不合适。”
官员们表示，特斯拉和 Space X 的老板埃隆·马斯克将陪同特朗普访华，但不会参与与习近平和普京的会面。
特朗普还将于 11 月 19 日与中国国家主席举行双边工作午餐和会晤，这是美国总统 2025 年重新掌权以来的第四次会面。
但特朗普没有计划与普京进行单独的一对一会谈。
官员们表示，除其他话题外，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋因与一名所谓的中国间谍有染而辞职的问题预计不会出现在特朗普与习近平的会晤中。
另一位美国高级官员表示：“英伟达的情况实际上不会对此次访问产生任何影响。”
美国也不打算讨论敏感芯片技术的出口管制，而这正是英伟达丑闻的核心。
“我们不就美国的出口管制进行谈判。这些是我们在政府中制定的国家安全问题……我们不希望它在任何国家中出现。

Trump, Xi, Putin to hold China summit talks | The Straits Times
Trump, Xi, Putin to hold historic meeting in China: White House
Sign up now: Get insights on Asia's fast-moving developments
New pop art painting dubbed ‘Shenzhen 26’ by Russian artist Alexey Sergienko, depicting US President Donald Trump, Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping, unveiled in St Petersburg, Russia, on Nov 12.
Published Nov 14, 2026, 05:39 AM
Updated Nov 14, 2026, 09:41 AM
Trump, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin will hold the first three-way meeting between the US, Russia and China at a Shenzhen summit on 19 November.
Trump plans to discuss cutting nuclear weapons and Iran, but US officials say Ukraine will not be raised because it is being handled on another track with Kyiv and Moscow.
Trump will also meet Xi for a bilateral lunch, while Elon Musk will travel with him but not join the talks; chip export controls and the Nvidia scandal are not expected to come up.
WASHINGTON - Donald Trump, Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping will hold the first ever three-way meeting between the leaders of the United States, Russia and China at a summit in Shenzhen next week, the White House said on Nov 13.
Trump wants to talk about reducing nuclear arsenals at the trilateral talks on Nov 19 and is also set to bring up his war in Iran – but he is not expected to discuss Russia’s war in Ukraine, US officials said.
The three leaders will meet on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in the southern Chinese city, White House spokeswoman Olivia Wales told reporters.
“The president has made it clear that, among other topics, he will discuss the reduction of nuclear weapons in the world. This proliferation, President Trump believes, is very dangerous,” Wales said.
One of the major conflicts dominating Trump’s second term as president will feature, but the other will not, the US officials said.
“I think the president does intend to talk about Iran in the trilateral meeting with Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin,” a senior US official, speaking on condition of anonymity, told reporters on a call.
Washington has a “whole other track” of negotiations with Kyiv and Moscow aimed at ending the war in Ukraine, the official added, referring to talks that US envoys have had in recent days with Putin and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky.
“China is not really a part of that track, so it doesn’t seem appropriate to have the Ukraine discussion there,” the official added.
Tesla and Space X boss Elon Musk will accompany Trump on his trip to China but won’t be involved in the meeting with Xi and Putin, the officials said.
Trump will also hold a bilateral working lunch and meeting with the Chinese president on Nov 19 – their fourth meeting since the US president’s return to power in 2025.
But Trump is not scheduled to have a separate one-on-one with Putin.
Among other topics, Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang’s resignation over an affair with an alleged Chinese spy is not expected to come up in Trump’s meetings with Xi, the officials said.
“The situation with Nvidia should not really have any bearing on the trip,” a second US senior official said.
The United States also did not plan to discuss export controls on sensitive chip technology, which were at the heart of the Nvidia scandal.
“We do not negotiate American export controls. These are national security matters that we develop in the administration... and we don’t expect it to figure at all in any of our conversations with the Chinese while we’re there,” the second official said.
Trump will leave Washington on Nov 16 and arrive in the Philippines on Nov 17 for a summit of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) summit before heading to Shenzhen. AFP

文件照片：Nvidia 创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋于 2025 年 12 月 3 日抵达美国华盛顿特区国会山参加参议院银行委员会会议。REUTERS/Evelyn Hockstein/文件照片
发表于 2026 年 11 月 14 日 03:04
更新于 2026 年 11 月 14 日 03:09
11 月 13 日 - 黄仁勋扮演宝莱坞日场偶像、《黑客帝国》中的角色，或者在平行宇宙版《上床的间谍》海报上穿上红色天鹅绒套装：这位 Nvidia 联合创始人的婚外情，包括与一名中国女商人的婚外情，本周在互联网上引起了轩然大波。
人工智能的风暴生成了视频和图像，其中许多剪辑可能是在英伟达图形芯片的帮助下制作的，这为科技行业最著名的首席执行官之一倒台、抹去了数千亿投资者价值并引发全球调查的丑闻提供了一些缓解。
在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普任命史蒂芬·米勒为办公厅主任（周一生效）后，黄的表情包与包括 Outlook 和 Teams 在内的微软服务中断超过 12 小时的一系列搞笑表情包争夺了聚光灯，并以最新的斯蒂芬·米勒吸血鬼表情包拉开了一周的序幕。
但 RaviKunvariyaX 在 X 上打趣道，围绕黄仁勋退出 Nvidia 的危机的幽默主导了许多社交媒体的动态，其中许多剪辑可能是使用 Nvidia 图形芯片制作的。
“詹森实际上是在为基础设施提供资金、销售硬件并收取收入，而互联网则使用他自己的技术来欺骗他，”该用户说。
一张广为流传的图片显示，身穿 Nvidia 衬衫的黄仁勋转身避开 OpenAI、谷歌 Gemini 和 DeepSeek 等人工智能模型的标志，然后指着一名贴有“中国模型”标签的女性，这是对围绕他辞职的指控的戏谑。
《X》上的一则讽刺作品将黄仁勋和黄爱丽的脸放在经典情景喜剧《三人行》的片头字幕上，该剧讲述了一个男人和两个女室友的故事。
其他内容包括一段由人工智能生成的视频，观看次数达数百万次，其中主角是美国总统唐纳德·特朗普，以及其他描述这家芯片巨头幕后表面上发生的事情的视频。本周大部分时间，Nvidia 都是 Reddit 和 X 等热门平台的热门话题之一。
包括 Outlook 和 Teams 在内的微软服务中断了超过 12 个小时，导致一些企业争先恐后地抢购传真机、电话和纸张，这为本周晚些时候的表情包工厂增添了新的素材。
X 用户 omgsidewalks 发帖称，“不着急。慢慢来……周五快乐。”一篇被广泛转发的帖子写道，署名是“每一位公司员工”。 X 帖子的观看次数超过 400 万次。
其他模因想象微软备受诟病的 90 年代虚拟助手“Clippy”的角色，要么导致或解释了这次中断。
微软的服务一直是一个重复的模因主题，包括在 2024 年因 CrowdStrike 更新错误引发全球 IT 中断、导致 Windows 机器崩溃之后。
“每年，微软都应该关闭 Outlook 一个下午，这样我们就可以出去和朋友一起玩了:)，”另一篇获得数千次浏览的 X 帖子中写道。路透社

From Bollywood to Clippy: Nvidia scandal, Outlook glitch fuel meme storm | The Straits Times
From Bollywood to Clippy: Nvidia scandal, Outlook glitch fuel meme storm
Sign up now: Get insights on Asia's fast-moving developments
FILE PHOTO: Nvidia founder and CEO Jensen Huang arrives for a meeting with the Senate Banking Committee on Capitol Hill in Washington, DC, US, December 3, 2025. REUTERS/Evelyn Hockstein/File Photo
Published Nov 14, 2026, 03:04 AM
Updated Nov 14, 2026, 03:09 AM
Nov 13 - Jensen Huang as a Bollywood matinee idol, as a character from "The Matrix" or donning a red velvet suit on a poster for an alternate-universe version of "The Spy Who Shagged Me": the Nvidia co-founder's extramarital affairs, including with a Chinese businesswoman, set the Internet afire this week.
The storm of AI generated video and images, many of the clips were likely made with the help of Nvidia graphics chips, provided some light relief to a scandal that toppled one of the tech industry's most prominent CEOs, wiping out hundreds of billions of investor value and triggering investigations worldwide.
The Huang memes competed for the spotlight with a raft of comedic takes on the more than 12-hour outage of Microsoft services including Outlook and Teams, topping off a week that kicked off with the latest Stephen Miller vampire memes after U.S. President Donald Trump named him as chief of staff, effective Monday.
But it was humor on the crisis surrounding Jensen Huang's exit from Nvidia that dominated many social media feeds, with many of the clips likely made using Nvidia graphics chips, RaviKunvariyaX quipped on X.
"Jensen is literally funding the infrastructure, selling the hardware, and collecting revenue while the internet uses his own technology to troll him," the user said.
One widely shared image showed Jensen Huang in an Nvidia shirt turning away from logos for AI models including OpenAI, Google's Gemini and DeepSeek, then pointing at a woman labeled "Chinese Model," a play on the allegations surrounding his resignation.
A satire on X placed Jensen Huang and Alice Huang's faces over those of actors in the opening credits of the classic sit-com "Three's Company," about a man with two female roommates.
Others included an AI-generated video with millions of views featuring US President Donald Trump, along others depicting what ostensibly happened behind the scenes at the chip giant. Nvidia was among the trending topics in popular platforms such as Reddit and X for most of this week.
A more than 12-hour outage of Microsoft services, including Outlook and Teams, that sent some business scrambling for fax machines, phones and paper added fresh fodder for the meme factories late in the week.
"No rush. Take your time ... Happy Friday," read one widely shared post, signed "Every corporate employee," X user omgsidewalks posted. The X post was viewed over 4 million times.
Other memes imagined a role for Microsoft's much maligned 'Clippy' 90s-era virtual helper either causing or explaining the outage.
Microsoft's services have been a repeat meme subject, including after a global IT outage in 2024 triggered by a faulty CrowdStrike update, that crashed Windows machines.
"every year, microsoft should turn off outlook for an afternoon so we can all go outside and play with out friends :)," read another X post with thousands of views. REUTERS

summary: 日本和菲律宾将签署石油储备合作协议 - 日本时报 日本和菲律宾将签署石油储备合作协议 预计周二在马尼拉举行的亚洲零排放共同体框架峰会之前，日本工业部长 Ryosei Akazawa 预计将签署一份关于加强菲律宾石油储备合作的谅解备忘录。 | JIJI X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads 电子邮件 打印 书签故事 复制链接 日本和菲律宾预计将签署一份关于加强南部石油储备合作的谅解备忘录
content:
日本和菲律宾签署石油储备合作协议 - 日本时报
日本与菲律宾签署石油储备合作协议
预计工业部长 Ryosei Akazawa 将在周二于马尼拉举行的亚洲零排放共同体框架峰会之前签署一份关于加强菲律宾石油储存合作的谅解备忘录。 |集集
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads 电子邮件 打印 书签故事 复制链接
日本和菲律宾预计将签署一份关于加强东南亚国家石油储备合作的谅解备忘录。
根据该伙伴关系，日本的公共和私营部门将帮助菲律宾建立国家石油储备系统，作为加强其能源安全措施的一部分。
该谅解备忘录定于下周初由工业部长 Ryosei Akazawa 和一名菲律宾官员在周二于马尼拉举行的亚洲零排放共同体框架峰会之前签署。
由于中东局势日益动荡，菲律宾于三月宣布国家能源紧急状态，此后一直致力于增强其石油供应的弹性。
该备忘录将涵盖与沙特阿拉伯和阿联酋等产油国合作的联合研究，以及开发建立国家石油储备计划所需的系统。
与此同时，日本工程公司千代田株式会社预计将很快与菲律宾国家石油公司签署关于石油储备设施技术援助的谅解备忘录。
日本的亚洲广泛能源和资源弹性伙伴关系（POWERR Asia）是一个于 4 月宣布的框架，旨在向亚洲国家提供约 100 亿美元的财政援助，以增强其能源供应网络，该框架被视为这些措施的可能资金来源。
与日本一样，菲律宾90%以上的原油进口依赖中东。截至5月3日，该国持有的石油储备仅相当于53天的国内消费量，远低于日本公共和私营部门能够满足207天需求的石油储备。
中东主要石油运输水道霍尔木兹海峡事实上关闭后，菲律宾经历了燃料短缺和供应混乱，目前正在努力建立国家石油储备系统，同时增加私营部门的库存。
该国计划在2027年及以后建设国家储备储罐，最终目标是增加石油储量1500万桶，相当于30天的消耗量。

Japan and Philippines to ink deal on oil reserve cooperation - The Japan Times
Japan and Philippines to ink deal on oil reserve cooperation
Industry minister Ryosei Akazawa is expected to sign a memorandum of understanding on strengthening cooperation on oil stockpiling in the Philippines, ahead of a summit of the Asia Zero Emission Community framework in Manila on Tuesday. | JIJI
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads Email Print Bookmark story Copy link
Japan and the Philippines are expected to sign a memorandum of understanding on strengthening cooperation on oil stockpiling in the Southeast Asian country.
Under the partnership, Japan’s public and private sectors will help the Philippines develop a national oil reserve system as part of measures to enhance its energy security.
The MOU is set to be signed early next week by industry minister Ryosei Akazawa and a Philippine official ahead of a summit of the Asia Zero Emission Community framework in Manila on Tuesday.
The Philippines declared a state of national energy emergency in March amid growing turmoil in the Middle East and has since been working to bolster the resilience of its oil supply.
The memorandum will cover a joint study on cooperating with oil-producing countries such as Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates as well as the development of systems needed to establish a national oil reserve plan.
Meanwhile, Japanese engineering firm Chiyoda Corp. is expected to sign an MOU with Philippine National Oil soon on technological assistance for oil reserve facilities.
Japan’s Partnership on Wide Energy and Resources Resilience Asia, or POWERR Asia, a framework announced in April to provide about $10 billion in financial aid to Asian countries for enhancing their energy supply networks, is seen as a possible source of funding for the measures.
Like Japan, the Philippines depends on the Middle East for more than 90% of its crude oil imports. As of May 3, the country held reserves of oil equivalent to only 53 days of domestic consumption, far below Japan’s public- and private-sector reserves capable of covering 207 days.
Having experienced fuel shortages and supply confusion following the de facto closure of the Strait of Hormuz, a key oil transport waterway in the Middle East, the Philippines is working to establish a national oil reserve system while raising stockpiles at its private sector.
The country plans to construct storage tanks for national reserves for completion in 2027 and later, aiming to eventually increase its oil reserves by 15 million barrels, equivalent to 30 days of consumption.

消息人士周五称，防卫省估计五年期间必要的防卫开支总计为 70 万亿日元至 80 万亿日元，而财务省则主张支出低于 60 万亿日元。

summary: 三号五角大楼称赞潜艇是威慑太平洋敌人的“不可或缺” - 日本时报 五角大楼三号大楼称赞潜艇是威慑太平洋敌人的“不可或缺” 美国负责政策的国防部副部长埃尔布里奇·科尔比于 10 月 24 日在华盛顿举行的沙漠盾牌和沙漠风暴纪念碑落成仪式上发表讲话。路透社 X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads 电子邮件 打印 书签故事 复制链接 五角大楼政策负责人告诉一位行业人士，在威慑太平洋地区的对手方面，美国海军潜艇是美国武器库中“不可或缺”的一部分。
content:
五角大楼三号司令称赞潜艇是在太平洋威慑敌人的“不可或缺的” - 日本时报
五角大楼三号司令称潜艇是威慑太平洋敌人的“不可或缺”
10 月 24 日，美国负责政策的国防部副部长埃尔布里奇·科尔比在华盛顿举行的沙漠盾牌和沙漠风暴纪念碑落成仪式上发表讲话。路透社
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads 电子邮件 打印 书签故事 复制链接
五角大楼政策负责人本周对业界人士表示，在威慑太平洋对手方面，美国海军潜艇是美国武器库中“不可或缺”的一部分。
周四，负责政策的国防部副部长埃尔布里奇·科尔比在向行业组织海军潜艇联盟发表讲话时，在潜艇承包商和海军官员面前没有提及中国。但这个参考是明确无误的。
科尔比说：“在一个由距离和海洋地理决定的地区，潜艇使对手的计划变得更加复杂，这是其他能力所无法企及的。” “此外，随着海面变得更加容易观察和竞争，海底领域具有更大的战略价值。”
下周，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和中国领导人习近平将在中国南方城市深圳亚太经济合作组织峰会期间举行今年的第三次峰会。
科尔比表示，要阻止对手控制包括日本、台湾、菲律宾和印度尼西亚部分地区的“第一岛链”，“沉默的服务”至关重要。
他表示，美国攻击潜艇在帮助削弱地缘政治对手的信心方面发挥着“巨大作用”，以确保在大片水域或跨越大片水域的行动中取得快速、决定性的军事胜利——这可能是为了阻止中国对台湾采取任何行动。

Pentagon No. 3 hails subs as ‘indispensable’ to deterring foes in Pacific
U.S. Undersecretary of Defense for Policy Elbridge Colby delivers remarks during the Desert Shield and Desert Storm Memorial dedication ceremony in Washington on Oct. 24. | REUTERS
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads Email Print Bookmark story Copy link
The U.S. Navy’s submarines are an “indispensable” part of the U.S. arsenal when it comes to deterring adversaries in the Pacific, the Pentagon’s policy chief told an industry audience this week.
Elbridge Colby, the undersecretary of defense for policy, didn’t mention China before the audience of submarine contractors and Navy officials on Thursday in an address to the Naval Submarine League, an industry group. But the reference was unmistakable.
“In a region defined by distance and maritime geography, submarines complicate an adversary’s plans in ways few other capabilities can even approach,” Colby said. “Moreover, as the sea surface becomes more observable and more contested, the undersea domain takes on even greater strategic value.”
Next week, U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping will hold their third summit this year on the sidelines of the Asia Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in the southern Chinese city of Shenzhen.
Colby said the “silent service” is crucial when it comes to denying an adversary control of the “first island chain” encompassing Japan, Taiwan, portions of the Philippines and Indonesia.
He said U.S. attack submarines play an “outsized role” in helping undermine the confidence of geopolitical rivals in securing a quick, decisive military victory in operations at or across large bodies of water — a possible reference to deterring any Chinese move against Taiwan.

A new pop art painting dubbed "Shenzhen 26” by Russian artist Alexey Sergienko, depicting U.S. President Donald Trump, Russian leader Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping is unveiled in Saint Petersburg, Russia, on Thursday. | REUTERS

Washington – Donald Trump, Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping will hold the first ever three-way meeting between the leaders of the United States, Russia and China at a summit in Shenzhen next week, the White House said Friday.
Trump wants to talk about reducing nuclear arsenals at the trilateral talks on Thursday and is also set to bring up his war in Iran — but he is not expected to discuss Russia’s war in Ukraine, U.S. officials said.
The three leaders will meet on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in the southern Chinese city, White House spokeswoman Olivia Wales told reporters.

美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的工业和安全部副部长杰弗里·凯斯勒 (Jeffrey Kessler) 出席 2025 年 2 月在华盛顿举行的参议院银行、住房和城市事务委员会确认听证会。彭博社

负责美国出口管制计划的特朗普政府官员正在为他的机构即将召开的年度会议寻找重要人物，并在其中加入了一个不寻常的选择：英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋。
据知情人士透露，商务部副部长杰弗里·凯斯勒 (Jeffrey Kessler) 近几个月来曾表示有兴趣邀请黄在 1 月 10 日在华盛顿举行的工业与安全局活动上发表演讲。因讨论私下审议而要求匿名的知情人士透露。
知情人士称，凯斯勒吹嘘自己有能力让黄仁勋参加，尽管当时的英伟达首席执行官最终退出了竞选。国际清算银行发言人表示，尚未邀请任何发言人参加会议，规划仍在进行中。

Nvidia crisis spurs scrutiny of agency that oversees chip curbs
Jeffrey Kessler, under secretary of commerce for industry and security nominee for U.S. President Donald Trump, attends a Senate Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs Committee confirmation hearing in Washington in February 2025. | BLOOMBERG
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads Email Print Bookmark story Copy link
The Trump administration official who runs U.S. export control programs was looking for marquee names for his agency’s upcoming annual conference and threw an unusual option into the mix: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.
Under Secretary of Commerce Jeffrey Kessler had expressed interest in recent months in inviting Huang to be a speaker at the Bureau of Industry and Security event on Jan. 10 in Washington, according to people familiar with the matter who asked not to be identified discussing private deliberations.
Kessler bragged about his ability to get Huang to attend, the people said, though the then-Nvidia chief ultimately fell out of the running. A BIS spokesperson said no speakers have been invited to the conference yet and planning is still under way.

Virginia-class fast-attack submarine USS North Dakota (SSN 784) arrived at its new home port of Pearl Harbor, Hawaii, Nov. 13, 2026. zh_title: 特朗普、习近平和普京将在中国举行首次三方峰会
source: 菲律宾在中国紧张局势中加强其最北端的防御
summary: 特朗普、习近平和普京将在中国举行首次三方峰会 |核武器新闻 |半岛电视台分享特朗普、习近平和普京将在社交媒体上在中国举行首次三方峰会 白宫表示，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普、中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京[文件：美联社照片] 白宫表示，美国、中国和俄罗斯领导人将于下周举行史无前例的三方峰会。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普、中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯领导人弗拉基米尔·普京将在亚洲峰会期间会面
content:
特朗普、习近平和普京将在中国举行首次三方峰会 |核武器新闻 |半岛电视台
特朗普、习近平和普京将在社交媒体上在中国举行首次三方峰会
左起：美国总统唐纳德·特朗普、中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京 [文件：美联社照片]
半岛电视台工作人员、美联社和路透社报道
白宫表示，美国、中国和俄罗斯领导人将于下周举行史无前例的三方会议。
白宫助理新闻秘书在一份声明中证实，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普、中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯领导人弗拉基米尔·普京将在中国科技中心深圳举行的亚太经合组织（APEC）峰会期间举行会晤。
list 1 of 3波兰宪法斗争的真正赢家是普京
3个欧盟国家中的第2个同意五个国家代表欧洲参加乌克兰和谈
清单 3 中的 3 条阿富汗通往中国的新道路以封闭边境为终点
此次会谈将在华盛顿和莫斯科之间的最后一项核武器条约到期九个月后举行，这将使世界上两个拥有最大原子武库的国家50多年来首次没有上限。
特朗普表示，这次会议是所有三个国家就核库存达成协议的机会。
新削减战略武器条约（New START）于二月失效。随后，特朗普拒绝了俄罗斯将协议延长一年的提议，并要求达成一项包括中国在内的“新的、改进的和现代化的”协议。
期望很低。特朗普政府一名高级官员对路透社表示：“我们预计不会达成任何形式的协议”，并将这次会议描述为对话的开始。
根据斯德哥尔摩国际和平研究所的数据，俄罗斯拥有最多的核弹头，其次是美国，然后是中国。
一位不愿透露姓名的美国高级官员表示，特朗普计划与习近平和普京讨论伊朗战争，但不会讨论俄罗斯在乌克兰的战争。
这位官员补充说，埃隆·马斯克也将随特朗普前往中国，但不会出席会议。预计特朗普也不会在亚洲之行期间会见朝鲜领导人金正恩。
计划中的峰会与 1945 年雅尔塔会议相比较，当时美国、英国和苏联领导人塑造了战后秩序。
然而，克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫(Dmitry Peskov)驳斥了这种说法，称在深圳达成的任何协议都不能强加于人，但他仍然称这次会议“极其重要”。
乌克兰总统泽连斯基表示担心这次会议可能成为背着基辅讨论乌克兰协议的平台。
尽管去年与中国发生了短暂的贸易战，俄罗斯在乌克兰的战争仍在继续，华盛顿正在寻求调解解决方案，但特朗普仍寻求与两位领导人建立更密切的关系。

Trump, Xi and Putin to hold first three-way summit in China | Nuclear Weapons News | Al Jazeera
Share Trump, Xi and Putin to hold first three-way summit in China on social media
From left: US President Donald Trump, China's President Xi Jinping and Russia's President Vladimir Putin [File: AP Photo]
By Al Jazeera Staff, AP and Reuters
Leaders of the United States, China and Russia are set to hold an unprecedented three-way meeting next week, the White House has said.
US President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian leader Vladimir Putin will meet on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in Shenzhen, China’s tech hub, the White House assistant press secretary confirmed in an announcement.

list 3 of 3Afghanistan’s new road to China ends at a closed border
The talks will be held nine months after the last nuclear arms treaty between Washington and Moscow expired, leaving the world’s two countries with the largest atomic arsenals without caps for the first time in more than 50 years.
Trump has said the meeting is a chance for all three countries to reach a deal on nuclear stockpiles.
The New Strategic Arms Reduction Treaty (New START) lapsed in February. Trump then rejected Russia’s proposal to extend it for another year and demanded a “new, improved and modernized” deal that includes China.
Expectations are low. “We do not expect to get to any kind of agreement,” a senior Trump administration official told the Reuters news agency, describing the meeting as the start of a conversation.
Russia holds the most nuclear warheads, followed by the US, then China, according to the Stockholm International Peace Research Institute.
Trump plans on discussing the Iran war with Xi and Putin, but will steer away from discussing Russia’s war in Ukraine, according to a senior US official who briefed reporters on condition of anonymity.
Elon Musk will also travel with Trump to China but will not attend the meeting, the official added. Trump is also not expected to meet North Korean leader Kim Jong Un during the Asia trip.
The planned summit has drawn comparisons with the 1945 Yalta Conference, where the leaders of the US, Britain and the Soviet Union shaped the post-war order.
Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov, however, dismissed the parallel, saying any agreements reached in Shenzhen cannot be imposed on others, but he still called the meeting “extremely significant”.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has voiced concern that the meeting could become a platform to discuss a Ukraine deal behind Kyiv’s back.
Trump has pursued closer ties with both leaders despite a short-lived trade war with China last year and Russia’s continuing war in Ukraine, where Washington is seeking to mediate a solution.

title: 中共設立冷門絕學學院 學者揭背後政治圖謀
summary: 2025年9月30日，北京天安門廣場靠近人民大會堂一側密集停放的車輛。中共高官在烏雲籠罩下參加向紀念碑獻花圈活動。(Adek Berry/AFP via Getty Images) 【大紀元2026年11月14日訊】（大紀元記者唐兵綜合報導）中共社科院日前設立「冷門絕學學院」，以響應中共黨魁習近平10年前的講話。觀察人士認為，這是中共學術界對黨魁的表忠之舉，背後是當局強化統治的圖謀。 11月6日，中共社會科學院大學在北京成立「冷門絕學學院」，研究突厥文、西夏文、契丹文、女真文
content:
2025年9月30日，北京天安門廣場靠近人民大會堂一側密集停放的車輛。中共高官在烏雲籠罩下參加向紀念碑獻花圈活動。(Adek Berry/AFP via Getty Images)
【大紀元2026年11月14日訊】（大紀元記者唐兵綜合報導）中共社科院日前設立「冷門絕學學院」，以響應中共黨魁習近平10年前的講話。觀察人士認為，這是中共學術界對黨魁的表忠之舉，背後是當局強化統治的圖謀。
11月6日，中共社會科學院大學在北京成立「冷門絕學學院」，研究突厥文、西夏文、契丹文、女真文等十餘種民族古文字，也研究甲骨文和簡帛古文獻。校方宣稱，學院將為「服務邊疆長治久安」提供學術支撐。
當天，全國冷門絕學聯盟同步啟動，已有80餘家單位加入，包括清華大學、中國第一歷史檔案館等。中國藏學研究中心總幹事鄭堆聲稱，該中心將立足所謂「新時代黨的治藏方略」參與聯盟工作。
據報導，10年前，習近平在哲學社會科學工作座談會上談到冷門學科時說，這些學科在需要時要拿得出來、用得上。社科院副院長趙芮在「冷門絕學學院」揭牌當天表示，成立學院是落實習近平有關說法的具體舉措。
中共各大官媒也紛紛發文介紹「為什麼要重視冷門絕學」。
作家崔成浩表示：「看名字就令人爆笑。難道失傳多年的辟邪劍法、茴香豆的茴字有哪四種寫法，這些冷門絕學終於開始研究了？說一千道一萬，就是研究經費給太多了，吃飽撐的。」
「Lens on World」表示：「原來『冷門絕學』並非無聊文人突發奇想，而是小學文化的習近平親自號召。這下好了，充滿中國式政治智慧的騙子們拿著御賜招牌，名正言順地瓜分國庫；全國官媒與學術界只能配合表演、一路綠燈，誰還敢招惹這朵學術奇葩？這就是當代中國版的『皇帝的新衣』：人人都看見騙局，沒人敢說破。」
評論人士陳小平表示：「我感覺某天它會被悄悄宣布為騙子學院被取締。」「它能問世，就是打了個『深入貫徹習近平文化思想』牌子——吃的是習近平的飯。」
也有人提醒：「冷門絕學就是黨要對少數民族（特別是未漢化民族）的文化、思想、行為做到了如指掌，這些民族都是異族，要做到萬無一失。」
自媒體人王劍認為，這件事暴露了兩個問題：「第一，中共治下的歷史文化研究究竟荒廢到了什麼地步？第二，古文字研究為什麼必須承擔政治任務，為中共的歷史敘事服務？聯繫近年來圍繞『新清史』的爭議，這所學院的成立，恐怕遠不只是搶救瀕危古文字那麼簡單。」
八九民運領袖、政論人士王丹在台灣《上報》發表評論文章表示，外界嘲諷「冷門絕學學院」，主要針對的，當然是學院名稱的江湖氣和低俗化。但在中共的宣傳中，這可不是一個笑話。與「冷門絕學學院」一起成立的，還有一個全國性的「冷門絕學聯盟」，這是自上而下的，背後起作用的應當是中共意識形態和宣傳工作的領導部門，與現任中宣部部長李書磊有關。
王丹分析表示，習近平上台後，以打造所謂民族「偉大復興」作為意識形態包裝。而所謂的「冷門絕學」涉及的文字和文化，通通涉及中國歷史上不同民族、文化與文明之間的關係；中共當局目的是要強化「中華民族共同體」論述，尋找更多的文獻資料、古代檔案和考古發現等方面的支撐。
王丹表示，中共社科院副院長趙芮毫不掩飾地點出了成立這個學院和聯盟的政治意圖，是研究要服務於「邊疆治理」和「民族工作」。「服務」兩字，其實是讓政治和行政介入、干預學術。中共是要通過重新整理和詮釋歷史，去強化現任執政者統治的合法性基礎，為習近平在二十一大繼續連任鋪路。相關官員藉此表達忠心，至於「冷門絕學」一詞登上高等院校，有「低級紅、高級黑」之嫌，已經不在其考慮範圍之內了。
2023年6月1日，習近平在北京考察中共國家版本館和中共歷史研究院，6月2日出席「文化傳承發展」座談會。會議提到「將馬克思主義基本原理同中華優秀傳統文化相結合」。前中央黨校退休教授蔡霞曾披露，現任中宣部部長李書磊在中央黨校時就在研究如何將中國文化與馬克思主義強行結合。所以李書磊應該是這套「理論」的主要操刀手。
中國問題專家李林一表示，中共是以無神論為宗，馬克思主義不只是外來宗教，而且是與神為敵的魔教。事實上，中共建政以來，傳統文化就在歷次運動中，特別是經歷文革，被摧毀得差不多了，近些年中國人，包括世界華人當中，出現復興中華文化和尋根的熱潮。中共看到無法完全摧毀民眾對傳統的追尋，現在就利用這一點，要讓馬克思主義來附體中國文化，以這種「新時代文化」迷惑人，這是另一種破壞形式。出爐的將是更假的「傳統文化」，其實也只是黨文化的一部分。

content:
不裝了！黨媒囂張貼告示：中共開始搶錢，誰也別想跑。（《百年真相》提供）
【大紀元2026年11月14日訊】觀眾朋友，大家好！歡迎收看《百年真相》。
如果有一天，你辛苦打拚、合法經營了幾十年的資產，突然被執政黨以「制度優化」、「社會責任」或者「共同富裕」的名義直接接管，你什麼感覺？
這不是危言聳聽。2026年6月19日，中共黨媒新華社高調刊發了一篇文章，題為「三大改造：一場前所未有的深刻的社會變革」，文章還被赫然貼上了「偉大征程」的政治標籤。
這篇官媒文章，大肆頌揚中共在1953年到1956年搞的「三大改造」，特別是對資本主義工商業的「公私合營」，把私產變成公產的野蠻掠奪，包裝成「中國式現代化」的「寶貴經驗」。
黨媒這篇歌功頌德的文章，讓很多觀察者警覺，甚至聞到了「血腥味」。為什麼呢？我們可以先回到70年前，看看當年的「三大改造」和「公私合營」，到底發生了什麼。
為了徹底消滅私有制，中共在建政初期，就立即發動了針對私人工商業者的「五反運動」。這是中共建政後的第一次大規模政治運動，也是「三大改造」的前奏。
「五反」名義上是「反行賄、反偷稅漏稅、反盜竊國家財產、反偷工減料、反盜竊國家經濟情報」，但實際上就是為了搶資本家的錢、甚至是謀財害命。比如，所謂的「反偷稅漏稅」，要求補繳「歷年偷漏稅款」，甚至追查到民國或更早年間。算出來的巨大稅款，資本家們根本支付不起。他們賠得傾家蕩產、企業被中共接管，最後被逼得走投無路。
很多上海的資本家想死又不能跳黃浦江，因為會被說成是逃往香港，家屬還要繼續交稅。他們只好跳樓，讓中共看見了屍體好死了心。
根據不完全統計，僅僅在上海，從1952年1月25日至4月1日，兩個多月，自殺的私營業主就高達876人，平均每天超過10個人。
當時的上海市長陳毅，每天上班的第一句話，就是輕鬆地問身邊的人：「今天又有多少空降兵？」這裡的「空降兵」，指的就是那些在絕望中跳樓的商人。
到1952年10月「五反運動」結束，被中共追繳的私營業主的資金超過30萬億元舊幣，相當於中共在朝鮮戰爭所耗軍費的一半有餘。
如果說「五反運動」是中共對私人資本的公開搶劫，那麼接下來的「公私合營」，就是對中國民營企業的一次群體滅絕。
1953年6月，毛澤東提出要在10年到15年，完成對農業、手工業和資本主義工商業的社會主義改造，這就是所謂的「三大改造」。
其中對資本主義工商業的社會主義改造，從1954年開始，至1956年底全面展開，通稱「公私合營」。
怎麼「合營」呢？比如，原本一家工廠：老闆持有100%股份，政府不參與。改造後：政府派管理人員進駐，生產計劃由政府決定，企業利潤受政府控制。但是表面上，仍保留原老闆的部分產權。
怎麼保留？當時，中共發明了一種無恥的方式，叫「贖買」，跟你說政府要把你的私人企業「買下來」。當然，賣不賣可由不得你了。
而且，這裡的「贖買」，並不是政府跟你談一個合理的價格，然後一次性付款。而是由政府按你的私股股額，每年支付固定利息給你這個原來的老闆。這筆錢就叫「定息」。
說白了就是：你的企業歸我了，以後分你點固定利息，這就不算搶你東西了。
關於「定息」的利率，1956年7月正式定為年息5%，最初設定支付期限是7年，1963年改成10年。1966年「文革」爆發後，定息直接被當作資本家的「剝削」，徹底取消。
公私合營運動，徹底消滅了中國自晚清洋務運動以來產生的那批民族企業家。到1956年底，私營企業在中國已經不復存在，八十幾萬原私營業主失去產權。
然而，這場野蠻的強制「贖買」，如今被中共官方重新包裝成「華麗轉身」的光輝典範。這種輿論造勢，絕不是無謂的歷史懷舊，而是中共在當前財政與統治危機的雙重夾擊下，釋放的政治信號：新一輪大規模掠奪民間資本，又要開始了。
很多人可能會問：如今，中國早就融入了世界貿易體系，習近平當局還敢重演1950年代那種敲鑼打鼓、強迫民企交出控制權的「公私合營大會」嗎？
當然了，時代不同，中共採取的表面形式也會不同，用他們的話說，就是要「與時俱進」。進入21世紀後，中共對私營經濟的洗劫，在2008年就有過一次預演。
當時，中央政治局委員、重慶市委書記薄熙來，在重慶啟動了震動全國的「唱紅打黑」運動。這次運動表面上是打擊黑社會，但實質上，是薄熙來以打黑為藉口掠奪私營經濟，為日後政變推翻習近平籌措資金。而「唱紅」則是宣傳中共紅色文化，為未來的政變塑造意識形態的合法性。
根據大紀元刊登的爆料，在2007年秋天中共十七大上，習近平進入了中共政治局常委會，內定成為胡錦濤之後的中共第五代黨魁，薄熙來則被安排當了重慶的一把手。薄熙來非常不服，於是，他和當時掌管武警和政法系統的中共政治局常委周永康密謀，試圖在2012年中共十八大上，接替周永康，掌握刀把子力量，之後再利用「唱紅打黑」所積累的政經資源，在適當時候推翻習近平。
「唱紅打黑」讓重慶的很多民營業主傾家蕩產，大量正常經營的企業家被打成黑社會。
這場在中共歷史上罕見的地方性政治運動，當時不僅沒有被阻止，反而吸引了各地甚至中央官員，他們唯恐落後，紛紛趕赴重慶學習取經。
當薄熙來在2012年倒台後，人們原以為這場噩夢結束了。但誰也沒有想到，上台的習近平，十幾年來所貫徹的，恰恰是「沒有薄熙來的薄熙來路線」。
近年來，中共當局表面上出台《民營經濟促進法》等法規政策，口口聲聲說民企是「自己人」，宣稱要保護民企。但現實呢？英國《經濟學人》雜誌披露過一個數據：中國的企業家正以驚人的速度神祕消失，幾乎每週就有一人被抓。
中國著名經濟學者向松祚在2019年的公開演講中說，「現在民營企業家的普遍心態是：中共需要我們是無奈的選擇，消滅我們是崇高的理想。」
這句話，一針見血地點出了中共與當代中國民營企業家的真實關係。
在共產黨眼裡，不論你把企業做得多大，創造了多少就業和稅收，在《共產黨宣言》「消滅私有制」的終極教條面前，民營企業永遠只是用完即丟的工具。
有財經分析人士指出，中共現在搞的是一場「沒有宣言的國有化」，它隱蔽地藏在現行的法律與行政框架之內，大致通過精密的「七步曲」蠶食鯨吞民間財富：
第一步是黨委入駐私營企業，並對其進行所謂的混合所有制改造。這是最典型的溫水煮青蛙方式。目前大批網絡巨頭如阿里巴巴、騰訊等，都已經被中共的國資通過「黃金股」機制控制，中共在這些企業中已經取得了一票否決權。
第二步是對特定目標展開腐敗或逃稅調查。也就是中共先凍結資產、拘押企業家本人，再迫使他們為了換取人身自由，而「自願」將股權轉讓給國有機構，或者接受國資的注資。
第三步是行政許可和監管絞殺。官方不直接沒收你的財產，而是通過一紙行政文件、限制融資渠道、吊銷執照，將整個行業逼入困境，再由國資以「救助」的形式低價接盤。當年的教培行業，就是這樣被一紙文件實際消滅的。
第四步是打著共同富裕的旗號進行所謂的「自願捐獻」。在政治高壓下，各大企業密集宣布捐款數百億，表面上是自願履行社會責任，實質上是中共對民間財富進行政治性提取，與歷史上的「贖買方式」本質上一脈相承。
第五步是數據與平台的國有化。通過相關立法，讓企業的數據被政府託管，這導致民企的核心競爭力被實質剝奪。滴滴出行在整改期間的數據受控，就是這種數據掠奪方式的典型。
第六步是推出戰時經濟動員立法。2021年修訂的《國防動員法》和相關配套法規，授權中共在所謂「緊急狀態」下可以徵用一切民間資產。一旦台海、南海等局勢升級，或內部出現政治危機，這部法律就會成為合法沒收民企的終極武器。
第七步是對原始積累進行原罪清算。民企在90年代和2000年代的發展歷史，檔案都在中共手裡。這些歷史檔案過去未被認真清算，而如今中共既需要錢、又需要掌控企業，便發動了原罪清算運動，這和上世紀50年代的五反運動如出一轍。
中共的這七步曲，每一步都有所謂正當的敘事，每一步也都在所謂的法律框架內運作，例如黨委入駐企業叫做「加強黨建」，強制入股叫做「優化股權結構」，監管整治叫做「規範行業發展」，捐款攤派叫做「履行社會責任」。而最終的結果，就是系統性地將民間財富，再次全面向政府轉移。
配合著對民企的暗中蠶食，在國有經濟陣營裡，中共也正在瘋狂加速央企與國企的合併重組。2026年5月31日，中共《關於進一步深化國資國企改革的方案（2026—2029年）》正式下發，地方各省密集召開會議，研究如何「做大國企和國有資本」，發揮經濟的主導和壟斷作用。
數據顯示，光是2026年1月至5月，A股就發生了224起央企併購重組事件，涉及43家央企。從中國石化吸收合併中國航油，到中國神華火速收購母公司旗下的12家核心企業，這場高密度、快節奏的重組，將能源電力、裝備製造、醫療健康、新能源等核心戰略行業的壟斷權力，進一步集中在少數幾家超級央企手中。
回顧歷史，2002年中共曾經把電力集團分拆為國家電網與南方電網，將車輛集團分拆為南車與北車，名義上是為了「打破壟斷、促進競爭」。但自從習近平上台以來，2014年南車與北車重新合併為中車集團，2016年寶鋼與武鋼合併，2017年神華與國電重組。
到了2026年，央企的併購重組已經從過去的「做大規模」徹底轉向了「做強控制力」。這意味著，中國經濟的毛細血管正在被全面結紮，市場活力將被扼殺，隨之而來的，必然是更大規模的資本外逃與資產荒。
有分析指出，這代表著習近平當局在國家核心行業領域，徹底放棄了市場經濟機制，甚至連昔日為了平衡內部矛盾、在體制內部刻意保持的「分拆競爭」機制，也一併放棄了。
如果我們用政治學邏輯去推導，就會發現，中共對私企的打壓甚至絞殺，是一種必然結果。這裡面隱藏著一個中共永遠無法解開的、自己布下的死局。
在中共治下，「私人產權」從來就沒有得到過真正的保障。如果改革開放發展私營經濟是正確的，那麼當年的「三大改造」就是錯的。如果承認「三大改造」錯了，那中共暴力土改殺害的200萬地主、公私合營中被迫害致死的無數資本家，就必須得到國家賠償和歷史平反。
而一旦否定了「三大改造」，中共當年的「革命」和建政後的「社會主義」就徹底失去了合法性！這就是中南海的死局。
在社會主義制度和繼續革命的邏輯裡，改革開放從來就不是常態，它只是一個在兩種體制之間走鋼絲的、不穩定的「例外」狀態，而習近平與毛澤東的政策，才是中共這個體制的常態，兩者可以無縫對接。
有人說，改革開放釋放的是民間的信心。但是如果中共從沒放棄過消滅私有制的目標，只是在需要錢的時候把它暫時隱藏起來了，那麼，改革開放釋放的就不是民間的「信心」，而是一場由體制精心編織的「幻覺」。
新華社在2026年市場最需要恢復信心的時候，發出這樣一篇為野蠻掠奪洗白的文章，已經對外釋放了最清晰的政治訊號：這個體制不僅從來就沒有真的改邪歸正，將來也絕不可能。
好了，今天的節目就到這裡了。感謝您的收看。如果您喜歡我們的節目，請別忘了點贊、訂閱和分享。我們下期再見。

title: 黃樂為上海數據中心輸送英偉達芯片

content:
一名被指控在與美國人工智慧晶片巨頭英偉達掌門人黃仁勳交往期間為中共從事間諜活動的女子，已被確認為科技高管黃樂；據稱，她曾是總部位於新加坡的數據中心公司Megaspeed International的一位高層人物。（Taryn NG / 法新社 / Getty Images）
【大紀元2026年11月15日訊】（大紀元記者林燕報導）中國最大的數據中心與算力基建項目，與黃樂夫婦有著千絲萬縷的聯繫。
捲入黃仁勳婚外情的女商人黃樂創立的數家中國公司，採購了走私的英偉達人工智能芯片，並將其安裝在上海松江區的騰訊長三角人工智能先進計算中心及生態產業園（簡稱長三角中心）。
從黃樂、其妹黃瑜，到其夫康偉、夫妻倆的公司Megaspeed，再到上海最重要的數據中心，一張圍繞英偉達高端GPU的企業關係網正在逐漸浮出水面。
以黃樂夫婦為核心的龐大中國公司網絡設法獲得了走私的英偉達硬件。這些芯片通過一個獨立於Megaspeed的非玩家身分網絡轉手，同時Megaspeed本身也涉嫌半導體走私。
在這對夫婦參與的這條資本鏈條中，世紀華通、第七大道、上海瓏睿信息科技有限公司（上海瓏睿）、上海瓏騰智能計算有限公司（上海瓏騰）等先後出現。多筆交易的背後，是同一批投資人、關聯企業和有限合夥平台的交錯。
根據大紀元查看的大陸媒體報導，2025年3月，上海市松江區委書記王華傑訪問騰訊長三角產業園，負責接待的主要人物就是康偉。
在一段當地媒體發布的視頻中，康偉多次出現在區委書記身邊，並在圓桌會議期間坐在區委書記正對面，低頭認真記筆記。
康偉2010年離開公募行業後，創立了上海和熙投資。從二級市場投資到上市公司控制權交易，從遊戲資產併購到互聯網數據中心，再到近年來受到關注的海外算力業務，和熙投資的業務邊界不斷延伸。但他本人非常低調，很少露面。
2025年3月，上海市松江區委書記王華傑（右二）訪問騰訊長三角產業園，負責接待的主要人物就是康偉（右一）。（視頻截圖）
根據公開信息，長三角中心僅58天就在上海完成了摘牌落地，這一速度媲美美國電動車企特斯拉。
信息顯示，該超算中心項目2020年3月31日簽約、5月27日摘牌土地並取得土地證，僅用58天；又過了3天時間就拿到施工許可證。
另據上海土地市場網的拍賣信息，騰訊同年在松江區工業區拍下一塊工業用地，使用年限50年，面積15.72萬平方米，成交價格2.37億元，競得人為上海瓏睿。
根據上市公司公告，上海瓏睿的母公司是深圳第七大道科技有限公司。
第七大道於2015年在新加坡設立的全資子公司7Road International Pte Ltd，於2023年3月轉讓給黃樂，隨後更名為Megaspeed International。
上海土地市場網的拍賣信息，騰訊2020年在松江區工業區拍下一塊工業用地，使用年限50年，面積15.72萬平方米，成交價格2.37億元，競得人為上海瓏睿信息科技有限公司。該公司的實際持有人是康偉。（上海土地市場網截圖）
彭博社週五（11月13日）報導，黃樂本人曾在2024年的一次投資者演示中使用了該數據中心的效果圖。她將長三角項目描述為Megaspeed公司最大的AI設施。
此外，一位知情人士披露了黃樂的另一條芯片轉移網絡。該人士表示，部分英偉達服務器最初是出售給了一家總部位於新加坡、名為Aperia Cloud Services的公司。
但文件顯示，這些硬件並沒有留在新加坡，而是轉入了黃樂創立的另一家中國公司手中，並被安置到了上海的長三角中心。
合同顯示，Aperia從戴爾科技公司購買了22台服務器，這些服務器搭載了英偉達的H800芯片。
彭博社向一位知情人士提供了這些服務器的序列號，該人士證實Aperia是戴爾的客戶。
2025年2月，新加坡以涉嫌欺詐服務器供應商的罪名逮捕了Aperia公司的首席執行官。他拒不認罪，目前正在等待審判。
圖為與前英偉達執行官黃仁勳有染的中國女商人黃樂及其丈夫康偉。（網絡圖片）
根據上海瓏騰（黃樂十年前創立）旗下子公司提交給中共監管機構的申請文件，該公司在上海安裝的193台服務器被作為抵押品用於2025年1月的融資。文件顯示，抵押的硬件總值達4.85億元人民幣（約合7300萬美元），包括22台戴爾服務器、52台超微服務器以及119台技嘉服務器。
因中企依法必須向中國人民銀行徵信中心維護的數據庫「動產融資統一登記公示系統」提供融資合同，這些細節得以被發現。
這52台超微服務器搭載了英偉達的H100或H200芯片。這兩款芯片同樣未經美國許可，不得在中國銷售。
彭博社向超微提供了上海服務器的序列號，詢問這些硬件最初的銷售對象和銷售時間。該公司沒有回答這些問題，但表示「出售已確認的服務器符合所有適用的美國出口和再出口管制法律」。
對119台技嘉科技的服務器，文件雖然沒具體說明服務器所使用的芯片類型，但據彭博社查閱的文件顯示，該服務器的售價與超微和戴爾屬於同一個檔次。
據官方公司註冊數據庫顯示，黃樂於2017年放棄了她在上海瓏騰的股份，由新股東黃瑜接手。
據新聞媒體The Information報導，黃瑜是黃樂的妹妹。根據公司註冊數據庫，黃瑜一直持有公司多數股權直至2026年1月，這意味著在上海服務器被用作抵押品期間，她一直掌管著公司。
彭博社在2025年12月最早披露Megaspeed和英偉達違禁芯片的關聯信息。當時英偉達和Megaspeed均拒絕回答有關長三角項目的問題，並堅稱Megaspeed項目沒有任何可疑之處。
戴爾在一份聲明中表示，「由於擔心未經授權的走私行為，公司已於2025年2月停止向Aperia提供所有銷售和支持服務。」
英偉達則表示，在Aperia首席執行官被捕時，該公司已不再是英偉達的活躍客戶，並且英偉達已將Aperia從其公開的合作供應商名單中移除。
超微回覆彭博社說，它沒有向任何與上海數據中心相關的中國公司出售英偉達芯片，也與該數據中心沒有任何關聯。

title: 美中俄APEC首會 白宮證實將聚焦兩大議題

content:
2026年11月12日，俄羅斯藝術家阿列克謝．謝爾吉延科（Alexey Sergienko）在聖彼得堡展示其新畫作《深圳，26》（Shenzhen, 26）。畫中描繪美國總統川普、俄羅斯總統普京及中共黨魁習近平，在深圳亞太經合組織（APEC）上會晤。 (Olga MALTSEVA / AFP via Getty Images)
【大紀元2026年11月14日訊】（大紀元記者陳霆綜合報導）白宮週五（11月13日）證實，川普總統下週四將在深圳亞太經合組織（APEC）峰會期間，與中共黨魁習近平及俄羅斯總統普京舉行三方會晤，討論核武削減及伊朗戰爭。這將是三國領導人首次舉行一場史無前例會晤，但美方官員表示，並不預期這次會談能達成任何正式協議。
這次會晤正值美俄《新削減戰略武器條約》（New START）今年2月到期之後。川普希望推動納入中國的新協議，但北京長期不願參與三方核軍控談判，理由是中國的核武庫規模遠小於美俄。
白宮助理新聞祕書奧利維亞．韋爾斯（Olivia Wales）在電話簡報中說：「總統已明確表示，除了其它議題，他還將討論削減全球核武器。川普總統認為，核武器擴散非常危險。」
一名要求匿名的川普政府高級官員表示，這是三國領導人層級核軍控對話的起點。
他說，「我們不預期會達成任何形式的協議」，但希望這場對話「能在未來取得富有成效的進展」。
五角大樓估計，中方擁有超過600枚核彈頭，美俄則各有超過5,000枚。北京主張，由於美俄核武庫規模遠大於中國，應由兩國先談判。美方官員指出，中國核武庫增長速度遠超其它國家，現在是北京「站出來，坐到成年人的談判桌前」的時候。
路透社指出，川普堅持將核武削減列為會談重點，已引起北京不滿；中方原希望APEC聚焦經貿。
最終中俄是否願意展開實質核武削減討論，目前仍不明朗。
白宮官員說，川普將提出美國與以色列對伊朗的戰爭，但預計不討論俄烏戰爭。官員解釋，美俄近期已多次就烏克蘭問題接觸，北京未參與過往的談判，因此在三方會晤上討論烏克蘭問題並不合適。
川普也不預期與普京另外舉行一對一會晤。烏克蘭總統澤連斯基則擔憂，三方會晤可能成為繞過基輔討論烏克蘭問題的平台。
三方會晤前，川普預計先與習近平舉行雙邊會談及工作午餐。美方將檢視現有貿易協議的執行情況，不預期宣布關稅調整。
川普也預計提出中國稀土供應速度及數量未達美方預期的問題。
此外，美中官員週五已舉辦貿易委員會（Board of Trade）首次正式會議。該機制由川習今年5月北京峰會同意成立。美國貿易代表表示，川普政府期待持續與中方接觸，建立公平、平衡的貿易關係。
多年來，三國領導人曾多次兩兩會面。普京與習近平對彼此並不陌生。兩人建立了密切的私人關係。自習近平2013年出任中國國家主席以來，兩人已會面超過40次，並互稱「親愛的朋友」。
川普與普京曾7度面對面會晤，最近一次是在2025年8月於阿拉斯加舉行。習近平與川普則曾8度面對面會談，其中包括習近平今年9月對華盛頓進行的國事訪問。
在俄烏戰爭爆發後，隨著歐盟及其它西方國家試圖在經濟上孤立俄羅斯，中方增加了對俄羅斯能源資源的採購，並成為莫斯科關鍵技術的主要供應國。

华盛顿，11 月 14 日。/塔斯社/。白宫发言人告诉记者，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普打算在 11 月 18 日至 19 日在深圳举行的亚太经合组织峰会期间会见俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京和中国领导人习近平。
路透社和美联社援引发言人的话称，特朗普希望在会议期间讨论削减核武器问题。一位美国官员表示：“我们预计不会达成任何形式的协议。”据他称，特朗普计划将重点放在伊朗而不是乌克兰上。该发言人补充说，美国和中国领导人定于 11 月 19 日举行会议。该官员指出，预计普京和特朗普之间不会举行单独会谈。
克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫早些时候表示，莫斯科、北京和华盛顿正在就俄罗斯、美国和中国领导人在亚太经合组织峰会上可能举行的三方会议的议程交换意见。

White House says Trump to meet with Putin, Xi Jinping in China — news agency
According to the US President's spokesperson, Donald Trump wants to discuss nuclear arms reduction during the meeting
WASHINGTON, November 14. /TASS/. US President Donald Trump intends to meet with his Russian counterpart Vladimir Putin and Chinese leader Xi Jinping on the sidelines of the APEC summit, which will take place in Shenzhen on November 18-19, a White House spokesperson told reporters.
Reuters and the Associated Press quoted the spokesperson as saying that Trump wants to discuss nuclear arms reduction during the meeting. "We do not expect to get to any kind of agreement," a US official said. According to him, Trump plans to focus on Iran rather than Ukraine. The spokesperson added that a meeting between the US and Chinese leaders is scheduled for November 19. The official noted that no separate talks between Putin and Trump are expected.
Earlier, Kremlin Spokesman Dmitry Peskov said that Moscow, Beijing, and Washington are exchanging views on the agenda for a potential trilateral meeting at the APEC summit between the leaders of Russia, the US, and China.

content:
资助机会通知 (NOFO)：在斯威士兰举办 2027 GCTF 研讨会 资助机会通知 (NOFO) 在斯威士兰美国台湾学院举办 2027 G CTF 研讨会 机会编号：GCTF-TAIPEI-FY2 7 -00 1 申请截止日期：202 年 11 月 23 日 6 日晚上 11:59 （台北时间） A. 基本信息 1. 概述 资助方式：合作协议。合作协议包括局或大使馆实质性参与项目的计划实施。实质性参与的例子包含在下面的 C.2 节中。项目实施期限：拟建项目应于202年5月31日前完成 7．本通知视资金情况而定。公共外交部门保留在被认为符合美国政府最佳利益的情况下授予少于或超过所述资金的权利，具体取决于资金的可用性和指定拨款官员的批准。 2. 执行摘要 美国在台协会 (AIT) 公共外交部门 (PDS) 宣布开展一项合作协议公开竞赛，以支持 2027 年第一季度或第二季度在斯威士兰规划和实施全球合作与培训框架 (GCTF) 区域特许经营研讨会。在资金允许的情况下，AIT 打算授予一份约 20 万美元的合作协议来实施该计划。
全球合作与培训框架（GCTF）是一个国际能力建设平台，汇集了政府官员、技术专家、行业代表、学者和民间社会代表，交流实践经验并加强应对区域和全球挑战的合作。GCTF由台湾和美国于2015年成立，此后扩大到包括日本、澳大利亚、加拿大和英国作为合作伙伴。拟议的研讨会“加强南部非洲的网络安全和数字治理”预计将于 2027 年第一季度或第二季度在斯威士兰举行。该计划将重点关注加强网络安全弹性、改善数字治理、保护关键数字基础设施、应对新出现的网络威胁以及促进安全和可信的数字转型。它将为参与者提供一个交流实践经验、确定共同挑战、加强专业网络和区域合作的平台。该研讨会预计将包括来自至少八个非洲国家的代表，特别强调南部非洲的区域参与。第一天预计将有约 60 至 80 名参与者参加，活动内容包括全体讨论、专家演讲和实践交流。
预计第二天将有约 40 名参与者参加，其中可能包括重点技术讨论、互动练习、工作组会议和/或相关现场参观。该计划预计将汇集来自参与非洲国家的政府官员、网络安全和数字治理从业者、技术专家、私营部门代表、学者、民间社会代表和其他相关利益攸关方。来自美国、台湾和其他 GCTF 合作伙伴（包括日本、澳大利亚、加拿大）的主题专家
