content: 💡 一直以來，我們十分重視與讀者和受眾的交流，也深信即使資訊環境變幻無定，只要找到方法看見彼此，始終有誰共鳴。《拾論》承先啟後，更進一步，撿拾讀者留言，同時讓相關編輯或記者主動回應留言，將端的最新動態及報導方向等一一為你補漏拾遺。 香港的狗隻風波從8月一直影響到10月。8月20日，打鼓嶺一間寵物酒店的負責人遭狗咬死，隨後漁護署大舉搜查格鬥犬，而品種大多由獸醫目測判定。於是有狗主的狗被帶走，必須先絕育才能領回，其中一隻惡霸犬更在絕育手術後死亡。到了9月，元朗又有一名27歲女子騎單車時遭流浪狗咬死。 進入10月，台灣先有一場風波。10月4日，蔡康永出現在民進黨台北市長候選人沈伯洋的競選總部成立大會，而就在前一天，台北一間同志酒吧剛遭警方搜查。儘管他至今沒有說明到場原因，中國大陸網民已經群起抵制，零跑汽車也隨即下架與他合作的所有內容。與此同時，台灣也有人翻出他的舊事，替他解釋動機。 幾天後，輪到華為陷入爭議。10月8日，懂車帝發布測試影片，指華為與江淮合作的尊界V800剎車踏板被踩斷，江淮股價因此連續兩天跌停，然而影片隔天就從各平台消失。10月11日，《人民日報》客戶端發文批評「速成車」，可是五天後，人民網總編輯便宣布離職。直到10月15日，工信部等三部門才成立聯合調查組。 此外，長沙的「黑白顛」性商訓練營近期也引起討論。這門三天的課程收費3000元，學員多是35到45歲、婚姻出了狀況的女性。課上導師教她們「不要跟男人硬剛」，而同一層樓還開著私處整形機構。 灣仔，寵物友善商場超市裡的狗。攝：鄧家烜/端傳媒 1. Cloudy ，回應《 香港狗咬人事故：從人寵共融到全城獵狗，狗隻管理鏈是如何斷裂的？ 》 我絕對支持人寵共融，但我同樣支持為貓狗絕育，降低人與動物衝突，同時亦減少無序繁殖帶來的棄養。在歐美地區，經由rescue領養的貓狗均有絕育要求。香港亦應在貓狗救助機構推廣「先絕育再領養」，如貓狗未夠絕育年齡，則在領養合約上加入限時絕育要求，並收取絕育定金。 2. kes ，回應《 專訪《反對普丁的無名先生》導演博倫斯坦：荒謬的宣傳，與被洗腦的人 》 非常出色的訪問，記者做了很多事前準備。謝謝。 「人們會說中國很糟，可是所有國家都很糟，所有國家領導人都腐敗，諸如此類。」 我的香港朋友也說過同樣的話。我明白，只要抱著這種思想，那就可以什麼也不做地過生活。 作出改變，甚至反抗，走上未知的道路，你可以嗎？ 3. wyvern ，回應《 評論｜ 最後一個公子：蔣萬安連任危機，與公子政治的黃昏 》 連勝文可以一剎間領先多位北市老將，是因為那粒子彈。4年後丁守中證明了他不比那位公子出色。 蔣萬安可以彈出，是在2016年那一個藍營大洪水時代，他是少數可以守住的立委。所以比其他2020年甚至2024年後才當選的立委優先出選。 4. 月的轨迹 ，回應《 出國打工的中國年輕人，在日本跌入「技能實習」困局 》 我也是长期生活在日本，我以为在日元长期贬值的情况下，技能实习对中国人吸引力应该很低了，没想到还是活跃黑产，让我很震惊。技能实习是现代奴隶制度我也以为早就是臭名昭著了，原来被中介包装的这么好😱！ 很佩服像刘星这样积极维权的人，以及支持团体坚持不懈的努力。众所周知现在的日本政府天天把外国人问题挂在嘴边，时不时拿来当政绩炫耀一下，真的非常需要这样外国人处境的深度报道，以及日本本国制度➕别国移民政策的深度比较分析。期待端持续关注这个话题。 5. ericchan ，回應《 「停止抱怨，做個真男人！」失去語言的男人們 》 最終她領悟：以她個人之力，其實是沒有辦法讓這些男性書友，嘗試著去為自己而活，那並不是她的使命 確實是如此。Carl Rogers的個人中心治療認為「每個人都是自己的專家」。作為他者，我們很難/基本不可能代替他人作出改變。但是這也不代表芊芊嘗試去做的事情沒有意義。向他人傾訴，在對話中釐清自身的感受也是慢慢鬆動自身一些maladaptive beliefs/schemas的過程。 而且即使是專業的諮商師也不可能自己說什麼來訪就能馬上作出改變的啊😂？ 專業的諮商師也會因為與來訪諮商感到耗竭。我覺得芊芊不需要對此感到罪惡感。這件事本就不是也不應是由你一個人承擔的責任，我覺得只需要在個人能力範圍以內多做一點就是一件很好的事。 6. koh ，回應《 「影子AI工作者」的秘密：AI提升效率，人類掩蓋痕跡 》 用AI創作最根本的倫理問題是在著作權，大語言模型裡海量的資料都是未經同意甚至暴力竊取而來的。這些資料經過AI公司"學習"之後就轉手出來賣錢，但作為原始資料的作者們一毛好處都拿不到，甚至會在市場上被同類競品擠壓。 這不是什麼手工對抗機器的問題，因為就算是用AI進行創作的人在這種環境也同樣無法避免被另一個用AI的人竊取成果。這種創作者無法受到著作權保護的世界，最後的贏家就只有掌握最多資源和AI技術的那些大公司而已。 桌上繪製了漫畫草稿的紙。攝：Philip Fong/AFP via Getty Images 7. 強詞奪理蘇偉榮 ，回應《 評論｜ 曖昧的蔡康永，與粗暴解讀下的政治現實 》 Well said "我認為在快速傳播敘事的時代，最值得警惕的是，眾多可能的解釋被壓縮成唯一的答案，而人們對答案的確信程度又遠遠超過證據所能支持的範圍，詮釋便開始取代事實，甚至取代了人們探求事實的能動力。" 非常精闢 8. listenchen ，回應《 「眼神給出去」的性商課，教的是媚男術，還是自我解放？ 》 有男性在參加的性商課嗎？還是男性參加的都是類似搭訕課？為什麼人們要選擇去討好與滿足這樣子的支配慾望跟佔有慾？為什麼不是以如何促進更好的對等、互動與情感連結關係去上所謂性商課？追根究底難道是因為男性的性喜好都是以這樣的方式被理解的嗎？身為男性我真覺得男性應該反省一下所謂來自‘’天性‘’的性偏好。 謝謝你的留言，據我了解這類性商課的受眾確實大多是女性。很難判斷對於這些學員的男性伴侶來說，性是不是最重要的擇偶標準，關係的破裂背後應該有各種複雜因素。我的感覺是，性商課提供了一套最簡單也最容易商業化的解釋方式，例如伴侶出軌說明你的性吸引力不夠，你可以透過上課來提升自己，修復關係。 學技巧很容易，但你提到的達成平等、情感聯結可能是最難的。為充滿不確定的關係建立了一種可控的解決途徑，或許這也是性商課有如此多受眾的原因。 特約撰稿人 譚衛紅 9. yunyin ，回應《 一個「好移民」能上街嗎？——10月17日之後的巴黎手記 》 謝謝分享在巴黎的感受，真的覺得社群上的某些討論好簡化和單一，有些即時新聞也很快的定調成「暴力抗爭」，台灣人真的很習慣無意識的要求社會運動要溫良恭儉讓，除非政府/警察的暴力已明目張膽，才願意接受一些些的回擊。 10. Esse ，回應《 解讀｜ 「銀鱈魚汞中毒」風波：被誤讀的是魚，還是吃魚的規則？ 》 脉络好清晰的科普文章，感谢作者和端（不禁想，在内地，这类关系到社会舆情的科普文章能在怎样的平台出现） 11. 真 ，回應《 中國式在家上學：短暫不輝煌 》 其實這就是學校體制需要改善，但學校不是家長開的，家長無權參與。其實就是沒有一個明確的系統可以確保每個孩子都被照顧到。我認為共生的系統其實比較可行，這樣有足夠資源的家長，可以進行一部分的自學，而不用完全脫離體制。 學校如果能多留一些時間給小孩，比方說學校半天，剩下的時間家庭保證能自學，也許也會是一個解方。 孩子們得學會自己使用自由的時間，但現在學校幾乎塞滿了學生應該要做的事情，常常忘了教育的本質其實不是讓每個孩子都“成功”。 也許這回到最基本的問題：我們這輩子到底要怎麼活？怎樣才能無怨無悔快樂生活？ 12. lnc ，回應《 評論｜ 從愛國公關到鐵拳公關，華為為什麼開始被批評？ 》 雖然很多人接受的所謂愛國教育已經把民族敘事、愛國這些概念內化成先驗的東西了。但敘事主體是國家、族群或政黨，而非企業。企業就應該在商言商，即使是所謂紅頂商人、民族企業或愛國企業家，也不會在宣傳產品的時候特意將政治屬性拿出來強調。即便企業掌舵人是人大政協，這些政治屬性很多時候只會在內部管治中作為平行的暗線存在，只在某些特殊時刻才會浮出來，目的通常也僅限於站隊表態表忠。 但華為卻把這些暗線的東西抬上來，由始至終地貫穿在產品營銷裡，並作為主要的營銷元素之一，這就已經足夠要提高警惕了。敘事主體變成了企業，甚至隱隱有不買就是不支持國產、就是不愛國的暗喻。產品本身的性能和品質反而被這樣的政治聲量蓋了下去，作為有點獨立思考能力的消費者都應該對這樣的宣發提高注意。 2019年5月29日，中國廣東深圳華為總部，一名員工正在為華為的新聞發布會做準備。攝：Jason Lee/Reuters/達志影像

title: 銀行倒閉拖垮總統：巴拉圭政局動盪如何牽動美中台角力？｜Whatsnew
summary: 11月3日，巴拉圭客戶數最多的Ueno銀行爆發金融危機倒閉，影響近300萬人口無法從帳戶中領取存款，民眾憤怒上街抗議。事件爆發後，總統潘尼亞（Santiago Peña）因與該銀行關係密切，6日遭到巴拉圭參議院全票通過彈劾並隨即遭到軟禁，總統一職由副總統、52 歲保守派政治人物阿里亞納（Pedro Alliana）宣誓接任。 巴拉圭的政權移轉與金融醜聞引發國際關注。巴拉圭是南美洲唯一目前仍與台灣維持正式邦交的國家，長期與北京保持距離，而前總統潘尼亞又與美國特朗普政府關係密切。
content: 11月3日，巴拉圭客戶數最多的Ueno銀行爆發金融危機倒閉，影響近300萬人口無法從帳戶中領取存款，民眾憤怒上街抗議。事件爆發後，總統潘尼亞（Santiago Peña）因與該銀行關係密切，6日遭到巴拉圭參議院全票通過彈劾並隨即遭到軟禁，總統一職由副總統、52 歲保守派政治人物阿里亞納（Pedro Alliana）宣誓接任。 巴拉圭的政權移轉與金融醜聞引發國際關注。巴拉圭是南美洲唯一目前仍與台灣維持正式邦交的國家，長期與北京保持距離，而前總統潘尼亞又與美國特朗普政府關係密切。近年來，美中在南美洲的外交與經貿競爭日趨激烈，中國持續擴大對該地區的投資與貿易影響力，積極爭取巴拉圭轉向，將之視為切斷台灣在南美最後據點的關鍵一步。因此，巴拉圭政局動盪是否牽動其對台、對中政策，也成為地緣政治觀察的焦點。 新任總統阿里亞納上台之後，美國國務卿魯比奧（Marco Rubio）也 祝賀 其接任總統，並稱美國致力於與巴拉圭人民建立牢固持久的伙伴關係；台灣外交部發言人蕭光偉也表示，台巴關係良好，巴拉圭的政局改變不會影響兩國邦誼，將擇期邀請新總統赴台。 2026年11月9日，巴拉圭首都亞松森，透過在抗議政府和Ueno Bank的示威中被砸碎的窗戶，可以看到Ueno Bank關閉後的辦公室內部。攝：Jorge Saenz/AP/達志影像 銀行倒閉引發的政治危機 綜合 美聯社 與 路透社 報導，11月3日，巴拉圭中央銀行決定將Ueno銀行置於破產管理程序之中，理由是該銀行償債能力比率（衡量資本與風險加權資產比率的指標）已跌至法定最低標準的一半以下。根據該銀行資料，Ueno擁有約近300萬客戶，占巴國650萬成年人口的六成；並管理8億至8.5億美元的公共資金。其中包括巴拉圭國家退休和醫療基金投資的約3.8億美元。 巴拉圭檢調第一時間下令逮捕該銀行的高層，包含 Ueno銀行的行長以及CEO一共八人。時任總統潘尼亞在第一時間 表示 ，已經要求巴國央行行長Carlos Carvallo辭職，並加速對客戶及公共資金的返還。他在社群媒體上發布貼文表示：「所有責任人都必須接受法院的審判，沒有任何例外或特權。」 然而，潘尼亞與Ueno銀行的母集團Grupo Vázquez的關係一直遭受質疑，他長期持有Vázquez的股份，直到2025年3月才售出； Carlos Carvallo的職務也是由潘尼亞所任命，他此前正是Ueno銀行的行長，此舉曾被控違反利益迴避原則。 根據 半島電視台 報導，Ueno銀行成立於1976年，本來在巴拉圭屬於小型金融機構，但在潘尼亞上任以後取得正式銀行執照，並進行了品牌重塑，在五年內迅速發展成為擁有70多家分行的銀行。 巴拉圭媒體《ABC Color》 報導 ，Ueno銀行遭到調查，起因為監管人員發現，該銀行向其母集團Grupo Vázquez的相關公司發放了1.46億美元的高風險貸款，且帳務的計算有誤，在校正過後發現緩衝資金不足法定限額的一半。 潘尼亞在上任前是國際貨幣基金（IMF）的經濟學家，巴拉圭也憑藉著近年來的低稅收、寬鬆的監管和穩定的經濟記錄吸引了外國投資者，2024年首次獲得信評機構穆迪（Moody’s）的投資級信用評級。自上任以來，潘尼亞也將自己塑造成國家與執政黨的改革者。他所屬的全國共和協會（Asociación Nacional Republicana），通常被稱為紅黨（Colorado Party），該黨自1947年以來長期執政，僅於2008年至2013在野，前後累計執政74年。 金融危機爆發後不久的11月5日，潘尼亞透過社群媒體 宣布 辭職，報導 指出 ，潘尼亞失去了紅黨重要領袖、參議員也是前總統的卡提斯（ Horacio Cartes ）支持；先前潘尼亞是在卡提斯的推舉之下參選總統。然而即便主動辭職，參議院仍舊選擇完成總統彈劾程序。最後在6日，巴國參議院以44:0（參議員共45人，1人缺席）通過潘尼亞的彈劾案，讓這位前總統喪失終身參議員的資格，以及刑事豁免權。 在彈劾程序通過以後，副總統阿里亞納宣誓繼任總統，潘尼亞也隨即被軟禁。 報導 指出，他被控利用總統職權，將數百萬美元政府存款存入Ueno；儘管已被告知這家銀行有可疑放款及償付能力問題，他仍隱瞞或淡化該行的財務困境。 另外，潘尼亞位於首都亞松森郊外的豪宅也遭到調查。潘尼亞2024年向該行成功申請2筆貸款，總額約50萬美元，用於興建這棟住宅；潘尼亞每月房貸還款金額高達3萬8000美元，相當於他擔任總統月薪的6倍。 2026年11月4日，巴拉圭首都亞松森，民眾在警察面前抗議政府和 Ueno Bank 。Ueno Bank因償付能力危機而被巴拉圭中央銀行接管。攝：Jorge Saenz/AP/達志影像 潘尼亞所面臨的指控還包含洗錢、資產來源不明（Illicit enrichment）、操弄金融監管機制、挪用退休基金等罪名，但潘尼亞本人否認一切不法的指控。 法新社 報導，阿里亞納上任以後，承諾不會放棄近300萬受上野銀行收購影響的儲戶，包括領退休金的人。並陸續在5日開始有條件發放「補償金額」；然而根據報導，是否能完全返還所有款項，以及資金來源等問題都未能釐清，也引起懷疑。 這場金融危機讓數千人走上街頭抗議，甚至連巴拉圭的足球也受到影響，因為Grupo Vázquez集團是多支球隊乃至於國家隊的主要贊助商，該國在阿根廷的分公司也停職30天且不支薪。 巴拉圭居民的反應 巴拉圭居民Lucía（化名）接受《端傳媒》訪問時表示，雖然自己沒有受到這次事件的影響，但巴拉圭社會整體相當驚嚇與手足無措。她認為，即便政府正在努力償還Ueno銀行留下的債務，但金額太過龐大，政府難以完全付清。 「潘尼亞與Grupo Vázquez需要出面負責，尤其如果潘尼亞的貪汙罪名確定——說實在的，也很難讓人相信潘尼亞沒有貪汙，他的支出是當總統月薪的六倍。」Lucía說。 她也提到，這起事件不只影響帳面上近300萬名儲戶那麼簡單——還包括失業的銀行人員、整個國家的商業活動等。她舉例，在她工作的地方，所有的商業合作案、專案計畫等已經全部暫停。 更嚴重的是，Lucía認為人民很難再次建立對政府的信任。這並非巴拉圭第一次有銀行倒閉，上一次是在1990年代末期到2000年初。此外，巴拉圭近年來是快速成長的經濟體，「外國的投資者如何有信心到巴拉圭投資？政府已經喪失了信用（Credibility），不只是外國資本，還有巴拉圭國民。」 至於會不會影響到2028總統選舉，她認為會，也希望會。「巴拉圭人也要想一想，我們已經被The Partido Colorado（紅黨）執政太久，但他們卻不斷貪汙，包含卡提斯、以及潘尼亞。」 2026年1月22日：美國總統特朗普在瑞士達沃斯舉行的第56屆世界經濟論壇期間，與巴拉圭總統潘尼亞在加薩和平憲章簽署儀式上握手。攝：Harun Ozalp/Anadolu via Getty Images 政治動盪成地緣政治焦點 根據《金融時報》 報導 ，潘尼亞是川普的堅定盟友之一。2024年，時任參議員的魯比奧曾經公開讚賞巴拉圭是南美洲的「榜樣」。川普也在上任之後，取消了前任總統拜登（Joe Biden）對巴拉圭前總統卡提斯所實施的制裁。制裁原因包括妨礙跨國犯罪調查、侵蝕民主制度、與真主黨有往來等。美國政府拒絕卡提斯與其子女入境，也凍結他在美國的資金與財產。 CNN 報導 指出，潘尼亞有許多施政措施都與川普保持一致，尤其在移民與安全問題的層面。潘尼亞曾透過國防和區域協調的協議與川普政府建立了牢固的關係，例如允許將來自美國的尋求庇護者轉移到巴拉圭的「安全第三國」協議。 美國「第三國遣返」計畫曝光：2.5萬移民被送往何處、又遭遇什麼？ 巴黎非營利新聞組織報導，特朗普第二屆政府快速擴大的「第三國遣返」網絡，如何將至少2.5萬移民送往原籍國以外的國家。遣送程序多有缺失，也可能違反國際法「不遣返原則」特朗普政府已與35個國家促成此類協議，至少投入4.1億美元。 美國與中國近年來在南美洲有激烈的外交競爭，已有多家研究機構包含 Brookings Institution 、 Council on Foreign Relations （CFR）的研究表明，中國在南美洲的經濟影響力已經超過美國，選擇與中國保持距離的巴拉圭，有其政治意義與獨特性。 專注於研究美洲地緣政治的非營利組織Global Americans執行長Diego Area 分析 指出，近期美巴關係大多依賴川普與潘尼亞的私人關係，巴拉圭政府也可以藉此表明雙邊關係並非僅有政治層面，而是在反貪腐層面上進行主動的合作，包括主動提供Ueno銀行案件的資訊。 巴拉圭政治顧問Sebastian Acha則認為，這起事件讓卡提斯重新在紅黨掌權，與美國維持關係的大方向會維持不變，但仍需觀察是否變成紅黨的政治清洗，以及2028總統大選前內部權力紛爭。而值得讚許的是，巴拉圭在24小時內讓總統下台，完成和平的權力交接，並未有軍事干預，這讓巴拉圭的盟友打消一定程度的疑慮。 巴拉圭與台灣 台灣與巴拉圭於1957年建交至今，雙方互設大使館。巴拉圭的長期執政黨立場親台，潘尼亞本人在2023年當選後，3年內已經訪台3次，最近一次是2026年5月。台灣也與巴拉圭有許多合作計畫，並採購農牧產品，根據外交部 資料 ，台灣目前是巴拉圭牛肉出口的第二大貿易夥伴、豬肉外銷的第一大採購國。 2026年5月8日，巴拉圭總統潘尼亞到訪台灣，與台灣總統賴清德一起出席歡迎儀式。攝：Ann Wang/Reuters/達志影像 然而，在台灣與中國的外交競爭下，邦交國每到選舉時，外交是否應該轉向中國都會成為討論焦點之一。2023年，潘尼亞的競爭對手、反對派候選人 Efraín Alegre就數度在接受媒體 訪問 時，主張要重新檢視與台灣的關係，並考慮與中國建立外交關係，原因是巴國的農牧業無法進入中國市場。 中國對於巴拉圭國會議員的拉攏手段也從未停歇，路透社3月的調查 指出 ，自2023年底以來，至少有19名巴拉圭國會議員、5名記者，以及一名具有總統參選意向的反對派政治人物訪問中國，且2025年訪問活動明顯增加，並且執政黨與在野黨都有人士參與。 對於巴拉圭政權交接後的後續情形，台灣外交部發言人蕭光偉 回應 ，巴國政情發展不會影響兩國邦誼及相關合作推動，新任總統阿里亞納堅定支持台灣，在擔任副總統與眾議院議長期間，多次公開重申台灣是巴拉圭重要戰略盟友。 阿里亞納原訂於11月24日訪問台灣，蕭光偉也說明，因情勢關係，阿里亞納就任總統，在此情況下會優先處理國政，後續會擇適當時機，再邀請他來台。 蕭光偉也說明，台灣在當地的援助計畫與業務往來的合作經費並未受到Ueno銀行倒閉影響，業務一切正常。

title: Chinese Cruise Missiles on NATO’s Southern Flank: Algeria Demonstrates Mach 4+ YJ-12 in Live Fire Test
zh_title: 中国巡航导弹袭击北约南翼：阿尔及利亚在实弹测试中展示4马赫以上的YJ-12
summary: 阿尔及利亚展示了中国YJ-12超音速反舰导弹的发射，特别是CM-302出口型，为非洲国家武装部队使用的先进海岸防御系统提供了罕见的视觉证据。阿尔及利亚国防部发布的视频显示，地中海猎鹰 2026 演习期间，移动式海岸导弹发射器发射，随后该武器击中了该国西部海岸线附近的海上目标。该导弹的宣称射程约为290公里，携带的弹头重量超过250
content:
阿尔及利亚展示了中国YJ-12超音速反舰导弹的发射，特别是CM-302出口型，为非洲国家武装部队使用的先进海岸防御系统提供了罕见的视觉证据。阿尔及利亚国防部发布的视频显示，地中海猎鹰 2026 演习期间，移动式海岸导弹发射器发射，随后该武器击中了该国西部海岸线附近的海上目标。该导弹宣称射程约为290公里，携带重量超过250公斤的弹头。其将 4 马赫和低空掠海飞行相结合，旨在减少防御战舰探测、跟踪和拦截来袭武器的时间。据报道，该导弹使用火箭助推器进行发射，冲压喷气发动机进行持续推进，并配有由中国北斗卫星导航网络支持的惯性导航系统和用于末端瞄准的主动雷达导引头。此次演习于 11 月 10 日在奥兰市附近举行，由阿尔及利亚总参谋长赛义德·查内格里哈 (Saïd Chanegriha) 将军监督，作为武装部队 2026-2027 年作战准备计划的一部分。阿尔及利亚国防部表示，目标被非常精确地摧毁。
该移动发射器似乎携带三个矩形运输和发射集装箱，与中国海防系统相关的配置一致。有关阿尔及利亚采购该系统的报道首次出现于2021年，而据信与该系统相关的车辆照片于2022年流传。这次采购反映了中国武器在阿尔及利亚国防订单中所占比例越来越大的更广泛趋势。对于阿尔及利亚来说，YJ-12提供了一种威胁敌对水面作战人员的重要手段，而无需其自己的军舰或飞机接近敌方部队。移动海岸发射器可以沿着地中海海岸线分散，从而给反舰导弹电池的位置带来不确定性，并使海军行动的规划变得复杂。当与海岸监视雷达、海上巡逻机和其他情报资产集成时，此类系统可以构建更广泛的网络，用于检测和攻击范围内的船只。这对于该国的海上拒止战略被认为是无价的，该战略的重点是在该国遭受攻击时不对称地对抗规模大得多的北约部队。阿尔及利亚空军已采购了许多中国导弹系统，其中 HQ-17 短程地对空导弹系统于 2026 年 9 月首次在该国出现，据报道该系统是在本世纪初购买的远程 HQ-9B 系统的补充。
阿尔及利亚在地面防空方面的大量投资，既扩大了对俄罗斯系统的采购，也越来越依赖中国装备，中国装备在很多情况下提供了更先进的替代方案。阿尔及利亚还被证实倾注了CHL-906移动综合电子侦察电子攻击系统。据报道，阿尔及利亚陆军预计将在本世纪末采购第一辆中国坦克 VT-4，提供先进的主动防护系统，同时有大量猜测称，除了采购俄罗斯 Su-57 第五代战斗机外，更先进的中国 J-35 战斗机也将采购。

【原文 English Original】
Algeria has demonstrated the launch of a Chinese YJ-12 supersonic anti-ship missile, specifically the CM-302 export variant, providing rare visual evidence of the advanced coastal defence system in service with the African state’s armed forces. Footage released by Algeria’s Ministry of National Defence shows a mobile coastal missile launcher firing during the Mediterranean Falcon 2026 exercise, with the weapon subsequently striking a maritime target off the country’s western coastline. The missile has a declared range of approximately 290 kilometres and carries a warhead weighing more than 250 kilograms. Its combination a Mach 4 and low-altitude sea-skimming flight is intended to reduce the time available for defending warships to detect, track and intercept an incoming weapon. The missile reportedly uses a rocket booster for launch and a ramjet engine for sustained propulsion, with an inertial navigation system supported by China’s BeiDou satellite navigation network and an active radar seeker for terminal targeting. The exercise took place on November 10 near the city of Oran and was supervised by Algerian Chief of Staff General Saïd Chanegriha, as part of the armed forces’ 2026–2027 combat preparation programme. Algeria’s Ministry of National Defence stated that the target was destroyed with great precision. The mobile launcher appears to carry three rectangular transport and launch containers, consistent with the configuration associated with the Chinese coastal defence system. Reports of an Algerian acquisition of the system first emerged in 2021, while photographs of vehicles believed to be associated with the system circulated in 2022. The procurement reflects a broader trend of Chinese armaments making up a growing portion of Algerian defence orders. For Algeria, the YJ-12 provides an important means of threatening hostile surface combatants without requiring its own warships or aircraft to approach the opposing force. Mobile coastal launchers can be dispersed along the Mediterranean coastline, creating uncertainty over the location of anti-ship missile batteries and complicating the planning of naval operations. When integrated with coastal surveillance radars, maritime patrol aircraft and other intelligence assets, such systems can contribute to a wider network for detecting and engaging vessels operating within range. This is considered invaluable for the country’s sea denial strategy, which has focused on asymmetrically countering much larger NATO forces in the event of an attack on the country. The Algerian Air Force has procured a number of Chinese missile systems, with the HQ-17 short-range surface-to-air missile system first seen in the country in September 2026, complementing the longer ranged HQ-9B by system that was reportedly acquired earlier in the decade. Algeria’s extensive investment in ground-based air defences has seen it both expand procurements of Russian systems, and increasingly rely on Chinese equipment which has in many cases provided a more advanced alternative. Algeria is also confirmed to have poured the CHL-906 mobile integrated electronic reconnaissance and electronic attack system. The Algerian Army is reportedly expected to procure its first Chinese tank, the VT-4, near the end of the decade, providing advanced active protection systems, while there has been considerable speculation that alongside procurements of Russian Su-57 fifth generation fighters, more advanced Chinese J-35 fighters will also be acquired.

title: Chinese AI labs are training models on Nvidia's Blackwell despite export controls, says ex-OpenAI engineer
zh_title: 前 OpenAI 工程师表示，尽管有出口管制，中国人工智能实验室仍在 Nvidia Blackwell 上训练模型
summary: 一位前 OpenAI 工程师的报告称，美国的出口管制并没有阻止中国的人工智能实验室使用受限制的 Nvidia 芯片。 Will DePue 今年早些时候离开这家人工智能巨头，创办了人工智能研究咨询公司 Unemployment Labs，他发布的法证证据显示，“DeepSeek、Moonshot AI、MiniMax 和 Ant Group 已经获得了使用 Nvidia Blackwell GPU 的权限，尽管这些芯片向中国出口受到限制，并且正在使用该硬件来创建他们的人工智能模型。” “这听起来很疯狂，但我发现几乎每个 AI 模型都带有 GPU 的隐藏签名
content:
一位前 OpenAI 工程师的报告称，美国的出口管制并没有阻止中国的人工智能实验室使用受限制的 Nvidia 芯片。 Will DePue 今年早些时候离开这家人工智能巨头，创办了人工智能研究咨询公司 Unemployment Labs，他发布的法证证据显示，“DeepSeek、Moonshot AI、MiniMax 和 Ant Group 已经获得了使用 Nvidia Blackwell GPU 的权限，尽管这些芯片向中国出口受到限制，并且正在使用该硬件来创建他们的人工智能模型。” “这听起来很疯狂，但我发现几乎每个人工智能模型都带有训练它的 GPU 的隐藏签名，”DePue 在社交媒体帖子中说道。 “当模型首次建立时，其权重的起始值会以取决于具体 GPU 的模式进行排列。GPU 和种子数的每种组合都会产生一个独特的模式 - 一种用于创建模型的硬件指纹。该模式的痕迹在训练到已发布的模型中得以保留。”听起来没那么疯狂。 Nvidia 首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 因与中国女商人黄仁勋 (Alice Huang) 的恋情被曝光而辞职，后者于 2023 年创立了新加坡 Megaspeed International。据报道，该公司因涉嫌向中国走私 Nvidia 芯片而受到美国当局的调查。黄仁勋的离职恰逢美国再次加强芯片出口管制。众议院议长迈克·约翰逊支持这个想法。
至少还有四项旨在限制中国获取尖端人工智能技术的法案正在等待审议：《人工智能监管法案》、《芯片安全法案》、《比赛法案》和《云安全法案》。 周一，美国参议员吉姆·班克斯（印第安纳州共和党）和伊丽莎白·沃伦（马萨诸塞州民主党）援引黄仁勋“与涉嫌中国间谍的关系”作为通过《人工智能监管法案》的理由，该法案将把特朗普政府现有的芯片出口管制编入法典。特朗普政府周四表示，不确定黄爱丽是否是间谍，北京方面否认了这一指控，目前正在接受联邦调查局的调查。不管怎样，现行规则显然不起作用。就在几周前，以色列安全公司 Lava 表示，它通过公开暴露的 IP 地址位于中国的监控端点发现了“32 个 Nvidia B300 GPU，属于 Nvidia Blackwell Ultra 一代”。 Lava 指出，这些 GPU 受到美国出口管制 [PDF]。该安全公司表示，其调查结果是由于用于内部基础设施管理的监控系统被公开曝光而得出的。 DePue 是如何得出结论的 DePue 咨询公司发布的分析报告《中国顶级前沿 AI 模型带有受出口管制的 Nvidia Blackwell GPU 的指纹》采用了不同的方法：分析中国 AI 实验室公布的各种模型的权重。
正如报告中所述，模型权重（与训练数据相关的参数）必须用某个值进行初始化。实现此目的的一种方法是使用称为 Philox 的伪随机数生成 (PRNG) 算法。该算法从种子值开始，每当运行时，该种子值都会生成相同的初始值集。使用 PyTorch，可以在 Nvidia 的 cuRAND 库的帮助下，通过创建并行工作的多个 GPU 线程来完成初始化。因为这个过程并不是真正随机的，所以可以选择一个芯片和一个种子值，为该硬件生成初始权重

【原文 English Original】
US export controls are not stopping AI labs in China from using restricted Nvidia chips, according to a report from a former OpenAI engineer. Will DePue, who left the AI giant earlier this year to launch Unemployment Labs, an AI research consultancy, published forensic evidence showing that "DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, MiniMax and Ant Group have gained access to Nvidia's Blackwell GPUs, despite restrictions on exporting these chips to China, and are using that hardware to create their AI models." "This sounds insane, but I discovered that almost every AI model carries a hidden signature of the GPU that trained it," said DePue in a social media post . "When a model is first set up, the starting values of its weights are laid out in a pattern that depends on the exact GPU. Each combination of GPU and seed number produces a unique pattern – a sort of fingerprint of the hardware used to create the model. Traces of that pattern survive training into the published model." It doesn't sound that insane. The resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang followed from revelations that he had an affair with Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang, who, in 2023, founded Singapore-based Megaspeed International. That company is reportedly under investigation by US authorities for allegedly smuggling Nvidia chips to China. Huang's departure coincides with a renewed push to tighten US chip export controls. House Speaker Mike Johnson supports the idea . And there are at least four bills awaiting consideration that aim to limit China's access to leading edge AI tech: the AI Overwatch Act, the Chip Security Act, Match Act, and the Cloud Security Act. On Monday, US Senators Jim Banks (R-Ind.) and Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.) cited Jensen Huang's "relationship with a suspected Chinese spy" as a justification for passing the AI Overwatch Act, which would codify the Trump administration's existing chip export controls. The Trump administration on Thursday said it's not sure whether Alice Huang was a spy, an allegation denied by Beijing and currently under investigation by the FBI. Whatever the case, the current rules clearly are not working. Only a few weeks ago, Lava, an Israel-based security company, said it had found "32 Nvidia B300 GPUs, part of Nvidia's Blackwell Ultra generation, through publicly exposed monitoring endpoints with IP addresses geolocated to China." These GPUs, Lava noted, are subject to US export controls [PDF]. The security biz said its findings followed from the exposure of monitoring systems intended for internal infrastructure management that were publicly exposed. How DePue reached his conclusion The analysis published through DePue's consultancy, "Top Chinese Frontier AI Models Carry the Fingerprint of Export-Controlled Nvidia Blackwell GPUs," takes a different approach: analyzing the published weights of various models from Chinese AI labs. As described in the report, model weights – the parameters that change in relation to training data – must be initialized with some value. One method for doing so involves a pseudorandom number generation (PRNG) algorithm called Philox. The algorithm starts with a seed value that produces the same set of initial values whenever it's run. Using PyTorch, initialization can be done by creating multiple GPU threads that work in parallel, with the help of Nvidia's cuRAND library. And because this process is not truly random, it's possible to select a chip and a seed value, generate the initial weights for that hardware and compare that pattern to a model's published weights. "I searched more than six trillion combinations of chip layout and seed number and matched them to open-weights models," said DePue. "In doing so, I found conclusive evidence that six Chinese AI models – including DeepSeek-V4-Pro, Kimi K3, and MiniMax-M3 – were initialized on Nvidia Blackwell systems. Four of the models match Grace Blackwell, the GB200 and GB300 parts in Nvidia's flagship liquid-cooled rack-scale systems." Noting that this is the first time MiniMax and Ant Group have been publicly linked to usage of Nvidia's Blackwell, he also cited several limitations to his approach. One is that usage of Blackwell GPUs doesn't prove where the GPUs were located, so it's possible some of these Chinese labs used this hardware through US providers – a loophole the Cloud Security Act aims to close. DePue's report includes initial seed values that linked DeepSeek-V3 to Nvidia's Hopper and DeepSeek-V4-Flash to Blackwell, for those who wish to attempt to reproduce the results. DuPue claims that multiple senior researchers, both independent and inside frontier AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic, have confirmed the result. Coincidentally, OpenAI and Anthropic have each complained about Chinese labs copying their models through distillation, a pastime also noted by the US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency. ®

title: Email addresses used in European school bomb hoaxes spotted in old infostealer logs
zh_title: 旧信息窃取者日志中发现欧洲学校炸弹恶作剧中使用的电子邮件地址
summary: 专家表示，两个用于发送炸弹威胁的电子邮件地址本周扰乱了数千所意大利学校，在信息窃取者日志中被发现暴露了一年多。哈德逊岩的研究人员调查了用于发送炸弹威胁的两个大学电子邮件地址。其中一个来自埃及 Kafrelsheikh 大学，早在 2021 年 10 月就被 Vidar 捕获，Vidar 是一种网络犯罪工具，可从受感染的计算机中窃取保存的帐户凭据和密码并将其泄露给攻击者。另一个来自台湾大耶大学，是在 m 中包含的 2.84 亿个地址中发现的。
content:
专家表示，两个用于发送炸弹威胁的电子邮件地址本周扰乱了数千所意大利学校，在信息窃取者日志中被发现暴露了一年多。哈德逊岩的研究人员调查了用于发送炸弹威胁的两个大学电子邮件地址。其中一个来自埃及 Kafrelsheikh 大学，早在 2021 年 10 月就被 Vidar 捕获，Vidar 是一种网络犯罪工具，可从受感染的计算机中窃取保存的帐户凭据和密码并将其泄露给攻击者。另一个来自台湾大耶大学，是在 2025 年 2 月的大规模 AlienTXTBASE 信息窃取程序转储中包含的 2.84 亿个地址中发现的。专家表示，这两个地址位于严格来说，infostealer 日志并不意味着炸弹威胁的幕后黑手使用之前的 infostealer 漏洞获得了对帐户的访问权限。然而，它表明大学和微软有足够的时间（两所大学都使用微软进行身份验证）对他们应该知道的出现在信息窃取者日志中的帐户采取行动。现代威胁情报使信息窃取者日志变得高度可见。哈德森·罗克 (Hudson Rock) 表示：“这两项发现都在中断发生之前就已经暴露了凭证，从而创造了一个重​​要的窗口，可以在其中调查和保护暴露的访问。”
研究人员表示，他们需要访问电子邮件标头等详细信息，以及来自电子邮件提供商的数据，包括登录事件和审核记录，这可以向他们展示更多有关谁发送了电子邮件以及来自哪个会话的信息。 Hudson Rock 指出，了解发件人是否通过帐户身份验证可以排除欺骗行为，但其本身并不能证明发件人使用了从信息窃取者日志中获取的相应密码。有很多方法可以绕过基于密码的身份验证。研究人员表示，在任何情况下，如果在信息窃取者日志中检测到凭据，负责这些帐户的组织都必须控制这些帐户，撤销其访问权限，轮换机密，并寻找可疑活动。研究人员表示：“这次破坏说明了为什么除了欺诈和数据盗窃之外，凭证暴露还值得关注。” “与普通大学用户关联的帐户可能成为联系学校、恐吓家庭和消耗紧急资源的一种手段。”威胁 11 月 11 日至 12 日期间，意大利 7,476 所公立学校中约有 6,300 所收到了虚假的炸弹威胁电子邮件，但其中只有约 390 所学校疏散了各自的大楼。
这些电子邮件包含诸如“我们将消灭你”和“我们将对意大利人进行种族灭绝”等信息，并提到“带有远程触发器的强大爆炸装置……”。早期报道表明，这些电子邮件来自台湾的电子邮件地址，签名者是“米哈伊尔·安德罗波夫，米索吉尼斯坦维拉亚特领导人”——这是一个虚构的国家或地区，大致映射为“厌女症之​​地”，其中“维拉亚特”的意思是奥斯曼帝国的一个行政区域。关于发件人的身份有多种说法，从电子邮件被泄露的菲律宾教师到俄罗斯支持的破坏行动。两者均未得到证实。俄罗斯否认有任何参与。意大利总理乔治亚·梅洛尼周四晚表示，这些电子邮件毫无可信度，无论谁是协调骗局的幕后黑手，都试图在全国范围内引发混乱。 “迄今为止，

【原文 English Original】
Two email addresses used to send bomb threats that disrupted thousands of Italian schools this week were found exposed in infostealer logs for over a year, experts say. Researchers at Hudson Rock looked into the two university email addresses used to send the bomb threats. One, from Egypt’s Kafrelsheikh University, was scooped up by Vidar – a cybercrime tool that steals saved account credentials and passwords from an infected computer and leaks them to attackers – as far back as October 2021. The other, from Taiwan's Dayeh University, was found among the 284 million addresses included in the massive AlienTXTBASE infostealer dump , dated February 2025. The experts said that the two addresses in infostealer logs do not strictly mean that those behind the bomb threats gained access to the accounts using the previous infostealer compromise. However, it suggests that there was ample time for the universities and Microsoft, which both universities used for authentication, to take action against the accounts that they should have been aware were appearing in infostealer logs. Modern threat intelligence has made infostealer logs highly visible. "Both findings place credential exposure well before the disruption, creating a substantial window in which exposed access could have been investigated and secured," Hudson Rock said . The researchers said that they would need access to details such as the email headers, and data from email providers, including sign-in events and audit records, that could show them more about who sent the email and from what session. Understanding whether the sender authenticated into the account could rule out spoofing, but would not in itself provide proof that the sender used a corresponding password taken from an infostealer log, Hudson Rock noted. There are many ways to get around password-based authentication . The researchers said that in any case where a credential is detected among infostealer logs, the organizations responsible for those accounts must contain them, revoke their access, rotate secrets, and go looking for suspicious activity. "The disruption illustrates why credential exposure deserves attention beyond fraud and data theft," the researchers said. "An account associated with an ordinary university user can become a means of reaching schools, frightening families, and consuming emergency resources." The threats Around 6,300 of Italy's 7,476 state schools received fake bomb threat emails between November 11-12, although only around 390 of them evacuated their respective buildings. The emails contained messaging such as "we will annihilate you," and "we will carry out genocide against Italians," and mention of a "powerful explosive device… with a remote trigger." Early reports suggested that the emails came from a Taiwanese email address and were signed by a "Mikhail Andropov, leader of the Vilayat of Misoginistan" – a fictitious state or region roughly mapping to "the land of Misogyny," with "vilayat" meaning an administrative region of the Ottoman Empire. Various theories have been reported about the identity of the sender, ranging from a teacher based in the Philippines whose email was compromised to a Russia-backed disruption operation. Neither are confirmed. Russia denied any involvement. Italy's Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni said on Thursday evening that there was no credence to the emails, and that whoever was behind the coordinated hoax sought to invoke chaos across the country. "To date, there is no evidence of a concrete danger," she said, ANSA reported. "These messages aren't intended to shock, they're intended to scare. "Those who write them are primarily seeking our fear, wasted days, suspicion, and chaos. Investigators and the judiciary, along with their European colleagues, are working to determine who is behind them." Schools in France, Ireland, Northern Ireland, and Scotland also received similar emails this week. None of the respective police forces believed the threats were legitimate. Hundreds of schools across the Republic of Ireland received the emails, as did news organizations such as RTÉ, which evacuated its Donnybrook campus, disrupting scheduled programming. Around 300 schools in Northern Ireland received bomb threats, although the PSNI said these were being treated as a hoax, and that the risk to the public was deemed low. Likewise, Police Scotland confirmed around 1,000 schools were affected by the email campaign and that the threats weren’t believed to be credible. In France, three school districts confirmed they received similar threats. Separately, domestic and international rail travel, including Eurostar services to London, were interrupted on Thursday following bomb threats made to Calais-Fréthun station. The latest wave of threats follows similar happenings at other types of organizations in recent weeks, including airline operators, air traffic controllers, and blood banks. At least 34 flights across various operators in Europe were affected earlier this month. Some were forced into unplanned landings, such as an Aer Lingus flight which pulled up to a French air base instead of its intended target of Rome. Military fighter jets were also scrambled to escort others in Italian and Austrian airspace. ®

title: Most affairs don't matter except to the people involved. Ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen's blunder will rock the world

summary: 这是一个与时间一样古老的故事。亿万富翁书呆子男孩遇见女孩。女孩后来被怀疑是间谍。 11 点的消息。哦，还有报道称他与一名直接下属的员工有染。当英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋犯下“浪漫”错误时，他不会半途而废。世界上最有价值的公司的老板——好吧，无论如何，直到最近——昨天，11 月 12 日公开辞去了首席执行官、总裁和董事会成员的职务，立即生效。我们不知道他是跳下去的还是被推的。他在承认有外遇后离开了。虽然他从来不
content:
这是一个与时间一样古老的故事。亿万富翁书呆子男孩遇见女孩。女孩后来被怀疑是间谍。 11 点的消息。哦，还有报道称他与一名直接下属的员工有染。当英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋犯下“浪漫”错误时，他不会半途而废。世界上最有价值的公司的老板——好吧，无论如何，直到最近——昨天，11 月 12 日公开辞去了首席执行官、总裁和董事会成员的职务，立即生效。我们不知道他是跳下去的还是被推的。他在承认有外遇后离开了。尽管他从未指定过外遇对象，但据报道，其中一件事是与黄乐（又名黄乐）发生的。她是中国公司 Megaspeed 的负责人，该公司是 Nvidia 的合作伙伴。 Megaspeed 被指控为中国政府的幌子，用于将 Nvidia 芯片转移到中国，尽管这一点尚未得到证实。一些美国官员还怀疑 [PDF] 她为中国情报部门工作，尽管美国司法部表示尚未就此得出结论。当《纽约时报》报道称詹森还与英伟达医疗保健副总裁金伯利·鲍威尔有染时，压垮了詹森的棺材。哎呀，伙计！此后，英伟达首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯 (Colette Kress) 被任命为临时首席执行官。我怀疑她不会在这个岗位上呆太久。首席财务官不是首席执行官。这些工作根本不一样。在大多数公司中，黄仁勋将被首席运营官取代。这不可能发生在这里。
Nvidia 没有 COO。无论是在 Nvidia 内部还是外部，黄仁勋都被视为 Nvidia，Nvidia 也被视为黄仁勋。如今，亿万富翁首席执行官被视为无所不知、统治一切的神王。很多时候，这都是废话。英伟达的情况并非如此。黄仁勋于 1993 年 4 月 5 日与他人共同创立了 Nvidia。他在第一天就被任命为首席执行官，此后从未离开过这个职位。起初，公司步履蹒跚。当它于 1999 年发布 GeForce 256 并将其作为首款 GPU 进行营销时，它开始走上成为 PC 游戏玩家首选芯片制造商的道路。今天仍然如此。这是一个巨大的利基市场，但它并不能让一家公司成为价值数万亿美元的企业。不，当 2006 年 Nvidia 推出 CUDA 时，就达到了令人眼花缭乱的高度。这种编程架构向科学和其他非图形工作负载开放了 GPU 的并行处理能力。从那时起，CUDA 将成为大多数高性能和人工智能计算的基础。黄是这一切的中心。直到现在他还是这样。在 KubeCon 北美（Kubernetes 的贸易展）上，超过一半的人工智能项目都使用了 Kubernetes，我与许多 Nvidia 员工进行了交谈。他们都提到了两件事。首先，他们处于震惊状态。也许中美两国的高层和政府官员都知道黄在玩火；我采访过的普通开发人员对此一无所知。
第二个是，黄仁勋每个月都会召开一次全体员工大会，他不是一场形式上的企业动员大会，而是回答每个人的问题，并给他们真正的答案。他很了解自己的技术，并且真正领导着他的公司，而不是仅仅给容易上当的股票买家留下深刻的印象。英伟达无法取代他。实在不行啊。我想起了 1985 年约翰·斯卡利 (John Sculley) 迫使史蒂夫·乔布斯 (Steve Jobs) 离开苹果公司的情景。如果你还没有老到记得的话，苹果公司曾一度表现不错，但到了 90 年代中期，它就迷失了方向。乔布斯下台后，苹果公司重新焕发了魔力，并开始崛起为世界顶级公司之一。

【原文 English Original】
It's a story as old as time. Billionaire nerd boy meets girl. Girl is later suspected of being a spy. News at 11. Oh, and it's also been reported that he was having an affair with one of his direct-report employees. When Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang makes a "romantic" blunder, he doesn't do it halfway. The boss of the world's most valuable company – well, it was until recently, anyway – publicly resigned yesterday, November 12, as CEO, president, and board member, effective immediately. We don't know if he jumped or if he was pushed. He left after admitting to having an affair. Although he never named an affair partner, one of the affairs was reported to be with Alice Huang, AKA Huang Le. She's head of the Chinese company Megaspeed, which was an Nvidia partner. Megaspeed is accused of being a front for China's government that was used to transfer Nvidia chips to China, although this hasn't been proven. Some US officials also suspect [PDF] she's working for Chinese intelligence, although the DoJ said it hasn't yet reached a conclusion about this. The final nail in Jensen's coffin came when The New York Times reported he had also allegedly had an affair with Nvidia's VP of health care, Kimberly Powell. Jeeze, guy! In the aftermath, Nvidia's CFO, Colette Kress, was appointed interim CEO. She won't, I suspect, be in the job for long. CFOs are not CEOs. The jobs aren't remotely the same. In most companies, Huang would be replaced by the COO. That can't happen here. Nvidia doesn't have a COO. Both inside and outside of Nvidia, Huang is seen as Nvidia, and Nvidia as Huang. These days, billionaire CEOs are perceived as God-kings who know all and rule all. Much more often than not, that's BS. That isn't the case with Nvidia. Huang co-founded Nvidia on April 5, 1993. He was appointed CEO on day one, and he never left the job. At first, the company staggered forward. When it released the GeForce 256 in 1999 , which it marketed as the first GPU, it started on its path to becoming the chip manufacturer of choice for PC gamers. It still is today. That's a great niche, but it doesn't make a company a trillion-dollar business. No, the path to that dizzying height came when, in 2006, Nvidia unveiled CUDA . This programming architecture opened its GPUs' parallel-processing capabilities to scientific and other non-graphics workloads. From there, CUDA would become the foundation for most high-performance and AI computing. Huang was at the center of it all. He still was until now. At KubeCon North America , the trade show for Kubernetes, used in well over half of all AI projects, I spoke to many Nvidia employees. There were two things they all mentioned. First, they were in a state of shock. Maybe the top brass and government officials both in China and the US knew Huang was fooling with fire; the developer rank-and-file folks I spoke to hadn't had a clue. The second was that every month, Huang held an all-hands meeting where, instead of a per-forma corporate pep rally, he answered questions from everyone and gave them real answers. He knew his technology well and actually led his company instead of just impressing gullible stock buyers. Nvidia can't replace him. It really can't. I'm reminded of when John Sculley forced Steve Jobs out at Apple in 1985. If you're not old enough to remember, Apple did fine for a while, but then by the mid-90s, it lost its way. Apple got its mojo back, and started its rise to being one of the world's top companies only after Jobs came back in 1996 . The big difference, of course, is that Huang's not coming back. I heard many people say that Huang was "too big to fail." True, morality no longer matters much in the US – see Trump's kleptocracy – but this is different. Huang betrayed not just his wife, but his board, employees, and stockholders. If, as some suspect, the board knew full well what was going on, they should be tossed out too, but that's a story for another day. Oh, and as for Trump's suggestions that Apple's former CEO Tim Cook should become Nvidia's CEO? Give me a break. Now the question of the day is: how can Nvidia recover from this blow? I don't think it can. I used to say that I didn't know where the AI companies were going, but I was sure that so long as capital kept flowing into Big AI, Nvidia was the one company you could count on that would make money . I think I was wrong. What does that mean? In the short term, Nvidia stock, after dropping 14 percent in early trading on Thursday, is down "only" five percent. Despite all the Sturm und Drang over Huang's departure, the NASDAQ is actually, when I wrote this, up. Even Nvidia's bonds are holding steady . Amazon and Google, which have their own horses in the AI TPU races, are hoping, of course, that Nvidia's misfortune will help them lever open the AI hardware market. In these early hours, I don't see that happening. Frankly, I'm amazed at how stockowners are shaking off Huang's resignation. The AI fever dream, for now, is continuing unabated. That said, can this go on? This irrational exuberance rests on the belief that, no matter what happens, AI will continue to rule the stock market. Eventually, though, the bubble may pop, and that could put some strain on the global economy. For now, people are ignoring how bad this blow is, or perhaps they're not aware of it. In a few years, I expect Huang's affair will be seen as the first needle in the AI bubble. ®

title: Microsoft outage renews European calls to detox from US tech
zh_title: 微软宕机事件再次引发欧洲呼吁戒掉美国科技
summary: 都柏林——周五微软产品大范围停运引发了新一波要求欧洲控制自己数字基础设施的呼声——尤其是在人工智能未来不确定的情况下。 Mistral 首席执行官 Arthur Mensch 周五在都柏林举行的首次人工智能会议上向欧盟国家领导人发表讲话后表示：“欧洲只有 20% 的数字服务运行在欧洲基础设施上。”花在外国、美国或中国技术上的资金“可以在这里再投资于我们控制的基础设施上，并为欧洲的研究和研究提供资金”
content:
都柏林——周五微软产品大范围停运引发了新一波要求欧洲控制自己数字基础设施的呼声——尤其是在人工智能未来不确定的情况下。 Mistral 首席执行官 Arthur Mensch 周五在都柏林举行的首次人工智能会议上向欧盟国家领导人发表讲话后表示：“欧洲只有 20% 的数字服务运行在欧洲基础设施上。”欧洲领先的人工智能前沿实验室的老板表示，花在外国、美国或中国技术上的资金“可以在这里再投资到我们控制的基础设施上，并为欧洲的研究和开发提供资金”。 Mensch 没有具体提及微软的宕机事件，此次宕机持续了近 24 小时，影响了 74 个国家的数百万用户。尽管如此，Outlook 电子邮件和 Teams 消息传递等关键工具的关闭还是影响了许多聚集在都柏林讨论欧洲人工智能未来的技术和政府领导人。法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙 (Emmanuel Macron) 在 X 上发表了一篇文章结束了这一天：“我们的独立性不能外包。它必须在国内、在欧洲建立，”他写道。 “在人工智能方面，欧洲也拥有竞争所需的一切。
我们没有时间可以浪费了。”出席领导人会谈的一位欧盟外交官表示，“我们需要加快速度、许可和投资，在世界市场上竞争，以拥有主权。”技术主权，包括对支持人工智能的云、芯片和模型的控制，一直是欧盟委员会主席乌尔苏拉·冯德莱恩第二次任期的战斗口号，也是周五欧盟 27 个成员国领导人聚会的关键议程项目之一。“我们将太多的数字基础设施外包给欧盟以外的参与者，”芬兰欧洲议会议员奥拉·萨拉在周五中断事件后的一份新闻稿中表示。她建议政府合同“必须特别支持欧洲技术”。其他人则专注于依赖几家大公司控制的数字基础设施所带来的风险。数字中小企业联盟秘书长塞巴斯蒂安·托法莱蒂（Sebastian Toffaletti）在与 POLITICO 分享的一份声明中表示，微软的宕机事件“提醒人们，数字基础设施集中于少数全球科技巨头所带来的系统性风险”。在英国，自由民主党科技发言人维多利亚·柯林斯 (Victoria Collins) 表示，这次中断表明需要制定数字主权战略，并表示：“我们需要采取紧急行动，停止对少数公司的依赖。”在德国，社会民主党议员约翰内斯·沙茨尔表示，这对公共采购提出了质疑。
他说：“衡量数字主权的标准必须是我们是否能够在这样的中断期间保持运行。”Joe Bambridge 和 Kilian Hocke 提供了报告。

【原文 English Original】
DUBLIN — Friday’s widespread outage of Microsoft products has sparked a new wave of calls for Europe to control its own digital infrastructure — especially with the uncertain future of artificial intelligence at stake. “Only 20% of European digital services run on European infrastructure,” Mistral CEO Arthur Mensch said in remarks Friday after he addressed EU national leaders during their first-ever meeting on artificial intelligence in Dublin. The money spent on foreign, U.S. or Chinese, technology “could be reinvested here, on infrastructure we control and [to] finance European research and development,” said the boss of Europe’s leading AI frontier lab. Mensch didn’t specifically address the Microsoft outage, which lasted nearly 24 hours and affected millions of users in 74 countries. Still, the shutdown of key tools like Outlook email and Teams messaging impacted plenty of the tech and government leaders gathered in Dublin to chart Europe’s AI future. French President Emmanuel Macron closed the day with a post on X : “Our independence cannot be outsourced. It must be built here at home, in Europe,” he wrote. “When it comes to artificial intelligence, too, Europe has everything it takes to compete. We have no time to lose.” An EU diplomat present at the leaders’ talks said that “we need to pick up speed, permitting and investment to compete on the world market, to have sovereignty.” Tech sovereignty, including control over the cloud, chips and models that power AI, has been a rallying cry of the second mandate of European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen, and was one of the key agenda items at Friday’s gathering of the leaders of the EU’s 27 member countries. “We have outsourced too much of our digital infrastructure to actors outside the EU,” Finnish European Parliament lawmaker Aura Salla said in a press release Friday following the outage. She suggested that government contracts specifically “must support European technology.” Others zoned in on the risk created by relying on digital infrastructure controlled by a couple of large companies. The Microsoft outage is a “reminder of the systemic risk created by concentrating digital infrastructure with a few global tech giants,” said Sebastian Toffaletti, secretary general of the Digital SME Alliance, in a statement shared with POLITICO. In the U.K., the Liberal Democrat party’s tech spokesperson Victoria Collins said the outage demonstrated the need for a digital sovereign strategy, saying: “We need urgent action to stop relying on a handful of companies.” In Germany, lawmaker Johannes Schätzl from the Social Democratic Party said it raised questions about public procurement. “Digital sovereignty must be measured by whether we can remain operational even during outages like this,” he said. Joe Bambridge and Kilian Hocke contributed reporting.

title: Jensen Huang’s resignation from Nvidia won’t end his problems with Congress
zh_title: 黄仁勋从英伟达辞职并不能解决他与国会的问题
summary: 黄仁勋可能已经离开了英伟达，但围绕他与一名中国间谍嫌疑人的关系以及这对美国国家安全可能意味着什么的问题只会变得越来越严重。这位亿万富翁周四的辞职并没有平息这一丑闻，该丑闻有可能波及英伟达董事会之外的范围，引发人们对特朗普政府放松对中国人工智能芯片销售限制的有争议决定的质疑。黄在制定这些政策方面发挥了重要作用。现在，国会想知道他与一家中国企业的个人关系是否
content:
黄仁勋可能已经离开了英伟达，但围绕他与一名中国间谍嫌疑人的关系以及这对美国国家安全可能意味着什么的问题只会变得越来越严重。这位亿万富翁周四的辞职并没有平息这一丑闻，该丑闻有可能波及英伟达董事会之外的范围，引发人们对特朗普政府放松对中国人工智能芯片销售限制的有争议决定的质疑。黄在制定这些政策方面发挥了重要作用。现在，国会想知道他与一名中国女商人的个人关系是否向北京泄露了敏感的美国技术或国家安全信息，以及政府官员对潜在风险的了解。据报道，尽管黄仁勋辞去了英伟达董事长兼首席执行官的职务，但他已同意在国会调查人员面前作证。这位前首席执行官和立法者一直在讨论闭门听证会的时间，这可能会解答他与一家涉嫌向中国人工智能实验室输送受限制的英伟达芯片的公司高管之间的关系。众议院的三名共和党委员会主席——众议员。 Brian Mast、John Moolenaar 和 Rick Crawford 在 11 月 4 日的一封信中要求黄提供证词，此时距他辞职还有一周多时间。
马斯特周四告诉记者，他的委员会仍然希望与黄进行对话，并补充说，他的工作人员最近在周三晚上就与黄的团队取得了联系。当天晚些时候，彭博社和 NBC 新闻报道称，黄已同意在没有传票的情况下出庭。在提出这一请求之前，《纽约时报》于 10 月 29 日对黄与 Megaspeed 高管 Alice Huang 的关系进行了调查。一年多来，美国情报部门一直怀疑这家公司与中国政府合作，帮助将受贸易限制的人工智能芯片输送到中国实验室。议员们担心黄爱丽可能还向北京提供了获取商业机密和敏感国家安全信息的渠道。主席们写道：“最近的报告对中华人民共和国获取美国敏感技术和信息提出了重大的国家安全担忧。” “中国渗透和获取美国尖端技术的问题是本届国会三个委员会调查工作的核心。国会确定美国国家安全面临风险的程度至关重要。”特朗普也可能受到牵连，但国会的审查不再局限于黄仁勋或英伟达。立法者越来越多地询问特朗普政府是否忽视了有关中国潜在间谍活动的警告，同时允许该公司扩大对中国的先进人工智能芯片的销售。
11 月 11 日，民主党参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦 (Elizabeth Warren) 和克里斯·库恩斯 (Chris Coons) 致信商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克 (Howard Lutnick)、国务卿马可·鲁比奥 (Marco Rubio) 和白宫幕僚长斯蒂芬·米勒 (Stephen Miller)，要求政府保留有关 Nvidia 芯片出口、可疑情报行动以及政府对 Megaspeed 调查的文件。参议员们特别要求提供有关据报道在特朗普 2026 年 5 月访问中国之前分发给高级政府官员的情报备忘录的记录。他们还寻求黄与特朗普之间的沟通、有关芯片出口限制的讨论记录以及有关政府汉密尔顿的文件。

【原文 English Original】
Jensen Huang may be out at Nvidia , but the questions surrounding his relationship with a suspected Chinese spy—and what it might have meant for American national security—are only growing more serious. The billionaire’s resignation Thursday has done little to quiet a scandal that threatens to reach well beyond Nvidia’s boardroom, raising questions about the Trump administration’s controversial decisions to loosen restrictions on AI chip sales to China. Huang played an influential role in shaping those policies. Now, Congress wants to know whether his personal relationship with a Chinese businesswoman exposed sensitive American technology or national security information to Beijing—and what government officials knew about the potential risks. Despite his departure as Nvidia’s chairman and CEO, Huang has reportedly agreed to testify before congressional investigators. The former CEO and lawmakers have been discussing the timing of the closed-door hearing, which could provide answers about his relationship with an executive at a company suspected of funneling restricted Nvidia chips to Chinese AI labs. Three Republican committee chairs in the House of Representatives—Reps. Brian Mast, John Moolenaar, and Rick Crawford—requested Huang’s testimony in a November 4 letter , more than a week before his resignation. Mast told reporters Thursday that his committee still wanted to speak to Huang, adding that his staff had been in contact with Huang’s team as recently as Wednesday night. Later that day, Bloomberg and NBC News reported that Huang had agreed to appear without a subpoena. The request followed an October 29 New York Times investigation into Huang’s relationship with Alice Huang, an executive at Megaspeed, a company U.S. intelligence had suspected for more than a year of collaborating with the Chinese government and helping funnel trade-restricted AI chips to Chinese labs. The lawmakers are concerned that Alice Huang may also have provided Beijing with access to trade secrets and sensitive national security information. “Recent reports raise significant national security concerns regarding the PRC’s (People’s Republic of China) access to sensitive U.S. technology and information,” the chairmen wrote. “The issue of PRC infiltration and access to cutting-edge U.S. technology is core to the investigative work of our three committees this Congress. It is vital that Congress determines the extent to which U.S. national security has been placed at risk.” Trump could be implicated, too But the congressional scrutiny is no longer limited to Huang or Nvidia. Lawmakers are increasingly asking whether the Trump administration overlooked warnings about potential Chinese espionage while allowing the company to expand sales of advanced AI chips to China. On November 11, Democratic Senators Elizabeth Warren and Chris Coons sent a letter to Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, Secretary of State Marco Rubio, and White House Chief of Staff Stephen Miller demanding that the administration preserve documents concerning Nvidia’s chip exports, the suspected intelligence operation, and government investigations into Megaspeed. The senators specifically requested records concerning an intelligence memorandum reportedly circulated to senior administration officials ahead of Trump’s May 2026 visit to China. They also sought communications between Huang and Trump, records of discussions about chip export restrictions, and documents concerning the government’s handling of its investigation into Megaspeed. The question, at the core of their inquiry, is whether national security concerns were sidelined as Huang and the Trump administration pursued policies that benefited Nvidia. Huang has been one of the tech industry’s most prominent supporters of Donald Trump. Nvidia contributed $1 million to Trump’s inaugural fund and $25 million toward the White House ballroom now under construction. Huang himself has visited Trump’s Mar-a-Lago resort in Florida and the White House numerous times, and has traveled with the president. His influence on U.S. export policy regarding AI chips is evident. He’s credited with persuading the Trump administration to allow sales of Nvidia H20 and H200 chips to China. Huang argued that letting the chips, and the CUDA software framework that runs them, proliferate around the world was good for America. Nvidia also agreed to pay the U.S. government 15% of revenue from H20 sales and 25% from H200 sales. Nvidia defended the arrangement last December. “The Administration’s licensing process will ensure that sales of H200 to authorized customers worldwide do not deprive U.S. customers of anything—and will in fact benefit American national and economic security,” spokesman John Rizzo said in a statement to Fast Company . “Offering H200 to approved and known commercial customers, vetted by the Department of Commerce, raises no cybersecurity risk and strikes a thoughtful balance that is great for America.” Those assurances now face renewed scrutiny. Megaspeed bought billions of dollars’ worth of Nvidia chips in recent years, including some of its most powerful Blackwell chips, which remain off limits to Chinese labs. A New York Times report last year described finding boxes of powerful Nvidia chips at a nearly empty Megaspeed office in Malaysia, raising suspicions that the company was serving as a conduit for restricted technology bound for China. There are also unanswered questions about the government’s response. The Commerce Department opened an investigation into Megaspeed last year, but the inquiry was subsequently transferred to the Department of Justice, with little publicly known about what happened afterward. The Warren–Coons letter seeks records that could help establish what senior Trump administration officials knew about the suspected Chinese intelligence operation, why the White House and the Commerce Department allowed chip shipments to Megaspeed to continue, and whether or not the White House disregarded national security recommendations to accommodate Nvidia’s commercial interests. These questions could become more consequential when Democrats take control of Congress in January. Coons, who is expected to chair the powerful Senate Foreign Relations Committee, has also called for an investigation into Huang and Nvidia to determine whether national security was compromised while Nvidia and the White House benefited financially from chip sales to China. “We need answers about the relationship between AI billionaires and the Trump administration,” Coons wrote on X . I’m pushing to investigate Jensen Huang and Nvidia to determine whether our national security was compromised. We need answers about the relationship between AI billionaires and the Trump administration, who's making these decisions, and who's really got their hand on the wheel. — Senator Chris Coons (@ChrisCoons) November 9, 2026 For Nvidia, meanwhile, the immediate consequences have been severe. Its shares have lost nearly a quarter of their value—24.6%—since The New York Times first reported on Huang’s relationship with Alice Huang on October 29. Nvidia has not publicly offered a detailed explanation for accepting Huang’s resignation. Its SEC filing simply states that the board accepted his departure. But the decision may have had less to do with the morality of Huang’s personal conduct than with the growing financial and political risks of keeping him in charge.

title: Jensen Huang and the end of the ‘lol nothing matters’ era of American politics
zh_title: 黄仁勋和美国政治“哈哈无所谓”时代的结束
summary: 本专栏涉及人工智能行业的各个方面。我的未婚夫在 Anthropic 工作。请在此处查看我完整的道德披露。周四上午，英伟达宣布首席执行官黄仁勋已辞去公司职务。英伟达长期担任首席财务官的科莱特·克雷斯 (Colette Kress) 将担任首席执行官，同时董事会正在寻找永久替代者。几个小时前，《纽约时报》报道称，黄有第二次婚外关系，这次是与一名下属。截至当天结束时，路透社爆料了第三个。首例报道的与疑似中国间谍艾丽克的恋情新闻
content:
本专栏涉及人工智能行业的各个方面。我的未婚夫在 Anthropic 工作。请在此处查看我完整的道德披露。周四上午，英伟达宣布首席执行官黄仁勋已辞去公司职务。英伟达长期担任首席财务官的科莱特·克雷斯 (Colette Kress) 将担任首席执行官，同时董事会正在寻找永久替代者。几个小时前，《纽约时报》报道称，黄有第二次婚外关系，这次是与一名下属。截至当天结束时，路透社爆料了第三个。第一个被报道的与中国间谍嫌疑人黄爱丽 (Alice Huang) 的恋情的消息导致投资者和其他首席执行官联盟宣布支持英伟达创始人。他们说，没有詹森的英伟达是不可想象的。然而到周四，不可思议的事情变成了现实。黄仁勋离开了他 33 年前在 Denny’s 共同创立的公司，而在 Nvidia 的公告中没有发表任何声明。不可否认，黄的垮台是一个悲剧，因为从很多方面来说，他都是一个美国非凡成功的故事：一个来自台湾的移民，9岁时被送到美国，用了30多年的时间把英伟达变成了世界上最大的公司。该公司在图形处理单元方面的深刻创新，包括使其可用于通用计算的软件，形成了一个庞大的生态系统，成为视频游戏、加密货币和前沿人工智能开发等多种行业的关键。
几乎所有人都认为，黄仁勋夸夸其谈、个人主义的风格对公司的成功至关重要，而公司的成功是具有里程碑意义的。（在他任职期间，英伟达的股票产生了 700,000% 的回报率。）它也适合这些夸夸其谈、个人主义的时代——当然，唐纳德·特朗普总统就是一个例子，但硅谷对创始人的崇拜也是如此。创始人拥有特殊地位，不应受到正常企业治理的约束，这是硅谷一些领先风险投资公司的信条。 Peter Thiel 的创始人基金于 2005 年成立，承诺永远不会将创始人从自己的公司中除名。安德森·霍洛维茨（Andreessen Horowitz）是管理资产规模最大的风险投资公司，它在其网站上承诺“永远不会公开批评任何企业家或初创公司”，并补充说“这样做是一种可被解雇的罪行”。 （不过，该公司有时确实会解雇创始人。）对创始人的崇拜是在一系列备受瞩目的事件之后出现的，在这些事件中，首席执行官因风投的干涉而被赶出自己的公司，最终损害了公司的利益。 Friendster 董事会在对创始人乔纳森·艾布拉姆斯 (Jonathan Abrams) 失去信心后，于 2004 年将其驱逐，之后又更换了几任首席执行官，最终尝试转向视频游戏，但注定失败。
Napster 时代结束后，肖恩·帕克 (Sean Parker) 被解雇了通讯录管理初创公司 Plaxo 的首席执行官，他接任 Facebook 首任总裁，并通过谈判让马克·扎克伯格 (Mark Zuckerberg) 获得了他至今仍享有的 Meta 投票控制权。最著名的是，苹果董事会将史蒂夫·乔布斯 (Steve Jobs) 赶出了苹果，导致该公司几近崩溃。当乔布斯于 1997 年重返苹果时，他拯救了这家公司——激励一代创始人将自己视为可以在正常业务范围之外运作的神话人物。对创始人的崇拜具有真正的价值，它使得投资者能够进行比以前更大、更长期的赌注。亚马逊、Meta、谷歌、Salesforce、

【原文 English Original】
This column touches on aspects of the AI industry. My fiancé works at Anthropic. See my full ethics disclosure here . On Thursday morning, Nvidia announced that CEO Jensen Huang had resigned from the company. Colette Kress, Nvidia’s longtime chief financial officer, will serve as CEO while the board searches for a permanent replacement.  Hours earlier, the New York Times reported that Huang had been in a second extramarital relationship, this one with a subordinate. By the end of the day, Reuters had broken news of a third .  News of the first reported affair, with the suspected Chinese spy Alice Huang, had led a coalition of investors and fellow CEOs to announce their support for Nvidia’s founder. Nvidia without Jensen was unthinkable, they said. By Thursday, though, the unthinkable had become reality. Huang departed the company he cofounded 33 years ago at a Denny’s without a statement of his own in Nvidia’s announcement.  There’s something undeniably tragic about Huang’s downfall, given that in so many ways his is a story of singular American success: an immigrant from Taiwan, sent to the United States at age 9, over 30 years he turned Nvidia into the world’s biggest company. The company’s profound innovations in graphics processing units, including software that made them useful for general-purpose computing, enabled a vast ecosystem that served as a linchpin for industries as diverse as video games, cryptocurrency, and frontier artificial intelligence development. Almost everyone agrees that Huang’s bombastic, personalistic style has been essential to the company’s success, which has been monumental. (During his tenure, Nvidia’s stock generated a 700,000 percent return .) It was also suited to these bombastic, personalistic times — exemplified by President Donald Trump, of course, but also by Silicon Valley’s cult of the founder.  The idea that founders have a special status and should not be subject to normal business governance is an article of faith at some of Silicon Valley’s leading venture capital firms. Peter Thiel’s Founders Fund launched in 2005 with a promise never to remove a founder from their own company. Andreessen Horowitz, the largest VC firm by assets under management, promises on its website to “never publicly criticize any entrepreneur or startup,” adding that “doing so is a fireable offense.” (The firm does sometimes remove founders, though.) The cult of the founder arose after a series of high-profile incidents in which CEOs were pushed out of their own companies by meddling VCs, to the ultimate detriment of the business. Friendster’s board pushed out founder Jonathan Abrams in 2004 after losing confidence in him, only to cycle through a series of CEOs before ultimately attempting a doomed pivot into video games. Post-Napster, after Sean Parker was fired as CEO of contacts-management startup Plaxo, he took a job as the first president of Facebook — and negotiated for Mark Zuckerberg to have the voting control over Meta that he continues to enjoy today. Most famously, Apple’s board pushed Steve Jobs out of Apple, leading to the company’s near-collapse. And when Jobs returned to Apple in 1997, he saved the company — inspiring a generation of founders to see themselves as mythical figures who could operate outside the normal bounds of business. There is real value in the cult of the founder, which has enabled bigger and longer-term bets than investors would previously entertain. Amazon, Meta, Google, Salesforce, and Netflix are among the tech giants that thrived under their original leadership. Y Combinator, which backed Stripe, Dropbox, Airbnb, and other generation-defining Silicon Valley companies, succeeded by making early bets on talented founders and not burdening them too much with meddlesome boards. For all the value that this approach has generated, though, it brought with it at least two major problems. One was that, as tech became an ever-larger part of the economy, the once-plucky founders who needed protection from overreaching VCs themselves became oligarchs: billionaires, centi-billionaires, and in Elon Musk’s case, a sometime trillionaire. The richer their companies became, the more successfully they used their power to lobby for their own interests. They established and defended monopolies, or near-monopolies, crushing competitors and narrowing the choices available to everyone else.  Meanwhile, the belief that they knew better than their investors expanded over time into a conviction that they knew better than the public, too. In social-media posts and interviews with journalists that grew rarer and more combative, they began to talk about threats to their wealth and authority as if they were threats to progress itself — and worked tirelessly to make sure their interests prevailed. Huang offered a vivid example of this phenomenon. Having legitimately played a key role in the technology behind the AI boom, he minimized any talk of the risks it might bring with it. Asked about the potential for loss-of-control scenarios in 2023, he told The New Yorker : “I know how it works, so there’s nothing there.” (He went on to say that AI functions similarly to a microwave.)  In his September interview with Ezra Klein , Huang dismissed predictions of catastrophe as irresponsible and argued that safety requires only better engineering and testing. To him, it was a technical problem that could be solved by companies moving even faster — and buying more Nvidia chips with which to do it. He brought a similar sense of grievance to his campaign against export controls. There are difficult tradeoffs involved in deciding to what extent chip sales to US adversaries should be restricted. Over time, denying China access to the upside of AI risks provoking significant conflict. At the same time, selling state-of-the-art chips to Chinese labs risks the prospect that ever-more powerful AI systems escape US control and are ultimately used against it.  Huang, who was reportedly terrified that his GPUs would be commoditized by the Chinese and so worked tirelessly to keep them within Nvidia’s own ecosystem, repeatedly resisted acknowledging that the tradeoffs even existed. When Dwarkesh Patel pressed him on the issue this year , Huang explicitly linked Nvidia’s fate to America’s. “Why would you want the United States to give up the world?” he asked. Later, he dismissed Patel’s framing of the risks as “childish.” To Huang, protecting Nvidia’s sales had become a patriotic obligation; the possibility that the US would benefit from a more measured approach to tech exports seemed almost impossible for him to entertain. The second big problem with Silicon Valley’s cult of the founder, and the flip side of entrusting flawed human beings with near-total power over their enterprises, is what investors call key-man risk . When hundreds of billions of dollars are at stake, it’s irresponsible for a company to have a single point of failure. And yet before news of Huang’s affairs broke, he was a 63-year-old man with more than 60 direct reports and apparently no succession plan. (He reportedly told colleagues he planned to run Nvidia until he was 120 years old.) When a company is generating 700,000 percent returns, no one wants to hear from the corporate-governance nags pointing out that one of the world’s most valuable companies is operating without a Plan B. Huang’s downfall shows why they should: you never know when behavior that was apparently already an open secret within some corners of Nvidia will spill into public view, destroying hundreds of billions of dollars worth of value and implicating an entire federal agency in a chip-smuggling scandal that now looks to extend well into 2027.  It would have been no slight to Huang’s accomplishments over the past decade for a board member to insist that Nvidia identify and groom a bench of successors. In fact, had he and the board ensured that a successor was prepared to take the reins, they would have won praise. (Tim Cook’s silky smooth handoff of the CEO job to John Ternus this year makes for a dramatic point of comparison; perhaps that's why Trump now wants Cook for Nvidia CEO.) Unfortunately for Nvidia, and the wider economy that has increasingly come to rely on it, no such precautions were taken. It must have been easy, in the era of Trump and Musk, to assume that accountability had become a thing of the past. To believe any company that is too big to fail must be run by a CEO too big to get in trouble. (Little wonder that Trump reportedly called Huang on Tuesday and urged him to keep his job, no matter how the CEO’s indiscretions may have compromised national security.) But the blue tsunami of this month’s midterm elections suggests that the “lol nothing matters” era of US business and politics may be coming to an end. It has become all too clear that with few exceptions, the ultrawealthy are rarely looking out for anyone’s interests but their own. In the end, like so many American giants before him, Huang was brought down by his sex drive. But the real scandal is that he thought only he could run the company he founded, and now the rest of us have to live with the consequences. A MESSAGE FROM OUR SPONSOR Who gave that agent permission? title: This Is the Problem With Oligarchy Right Here

summary: 在收件箱中阅读当天的头条新闻。在此订阅《每日展望》时事通讯。周四上午，黄仁勋辞去英伟达首席执行官一职。前一天，人们知道他除了与一名中国间谍有染之外，还发生了另一件事，这次是与该公司负责医疗保健的副总裁金伯利·鲍威尔(Kimberly Powell)。英伟达董事会将解雇他的消息很快传出，黄仁勋放弃了，并于周四上午辞职。这引发了市场混乱。英伟达股价开盘后暴跌逾 10%，但随后反弹
content:
在收件箱中阅读当天的头条新闻。在此订阅《每日展望》时事通讯。周四上午，黄仁勋辞去英伟达首席执行官一职。前一天，人们知道他除了与一名中国间谍有染之外，还发生了另一件事，这次是与该公司负责医疗保健的副总裁金伯利·鲍威尔(Kimberly Powell)。英伟达董事会将解雇他的消息很快传出，黄仁勋放弃了，并于周四上午辞职。这引发了市场混乱。开盘后，英伟达股价暴跌逾 10%，但随后有所反弹。截至撰写本文时，该价格已从周五的 193 美元跌至 160 美元。几天之内，市值就蒸发了 8000 亿美元。现在我们都在提心吊胆地等着看这起庸俗的丑闻是否会引发经济危机，或者黄的可能离婚会产生什么巨大的影响。他与结婚 40 年的妻子 Lori Huang 没有签订婚前协议，根据加州法律，如果他们离婚，她将获得一半的累积财富；她将成为亿万富翁。这笔钱可以买到很大的影响力。会是好是坏？收件箱中的潜在客户分析通过深入、渐进的报告超越噪音。注册 没有付费专区，没有程序化广告——只有报告。随时取消订阅。提交电子邮件即表示您订阅了我们的工作日早间通讯《每日展望》。
黄仁勋之所以出局，是因为英伟达是治理得更好的科技公司之一。与 Meta、Alphabet（谷歌的母公司）、Snap，当然还有 SpaceX 不同，英伟达没有双层股权结构，即公司的创始人尽管只拥有少数股份，却获得了对公司的完全控制权。正如我之前所写，这种做法使上市公司的整个论点变得混乱，并大大增加了糟糕商业决策的风险。如果马克·扎克伯格拒绝离开，董事会、股东和公众压力都无法将马克·扎克伯格从 Meta 的大椅子上撬下来，无论他在一些愚蠢的虚拟宇宙废话上浪费了多少数百亿美元。但由于黄和他的妻子只控制着公司约3.6%的股份，英伟达董事会和股东拥有实权。当他搞砸得够严重的时候，就这样了。尽管如此，黄在很多方面仍然让自己成为了业务的中心。他是典型的硅谷英雄创始人，总是穿着他标志性的皮夹克，在世界各地受到名人般的对待。据报道，他有 60 名直接向他汇报的人，而传统的首席执行官只有 5 到 7 名。正如我在写关于黄的第一次被报道的事件时，这一混乱给全球社会留下了多个巨大的问号。
需要明确的是，我不相信英雄创始人的神话；我不相信英雄创始人的神话。毫无疑问，英伟达或其他地方的某个人可以像他一样出色地完成这项工作。（只要不要违法或欺骗你的配偶，你就已经成功了一半。）也就是说，华尔街和散户投资者中的许多人确实相信英雄创始人神话可以创造一个自我实现的预言。具体来说，黄的奇怪的管理风格将意味着新任首席执行官要么必须适应一种高度非正统的方法，要么进行重大的组织重组，这可能会扰乱业务。寡头和中国间谍：谁对我的威胁更大

【原文 English Original】
Read the top story of the day in your inbox. Sign up for the Daily Prospect newsletter here. On Thursday morning, Jensen Huang resigned as CEO of Nvidia. On the day before, it had become known that he’d been having another affair alongside the one he’d been having with a Chinese spy, this time with Kimberly Powell, the company’s vice president of health care. It quickly leaked that the Nvidia board was going to sack him, and Huang gave up and quit Thursday morning. This unleashed chaos in the markets. Nvidia stock had plummeted by more than 10 percent after trading opened, though it bounced back somewhat after that. At time of writing, it was down to $160, from its Friday price of $193. That is something like $800 billion in market capitalization gone in the space of a few days. Now we all get to wait on tenterhooks to see if this tawdry scandal touches off an economic crisis, or what huge ramifications come out of Huang’s likely divorce. He has no prenuptial agreement with his wife of 40 years, Lori Huang, and if they divorce, under California’s law that gives her half of the accrued wealth; she will become a mega-billionaire. That money buys a lot of influence. Will it be good or bad? The Prospect in your inbox Analysis that goes beyond the noise with in-depth, progressive reporting. Sign up No paywall, no programmatic ads — just the reporting. Unsubscribe anytime. Submitting your email signs you up for The Daily Prospect, our weekday morning newsletter. Huang is out because, remarkably enough, Nvidia is one of the better-governed tech companies. Unlike Meta, Alphabet (Google’s parent company), Snap, and of course SpaceX, Nvidia does not have a dual-class share structure, in which the company’s founder(s) get total control over the company despite only owning a minority of the shares. As I have previously written , that practice makes a hash of the entire argument for a public corporation and greatly increases the risk of poor business decisions. Neither the board, nor shareholders, nor public pressure could pry Mark Zuckerberg out of the big chair at Meta if he refuses to leave, no matter how many tens of billions of dollars he wastes on some cockamamie metaverse nonsense. But because Huang and his wife only control about 3.6 percent of the company, the Nvidia board and shareholders have real power. When he screwed up badly enough, that was it. That said, Huang had still made himself the center of the business in many ways. He was a quintessential Silicon Valley hero-founder, always wearing his signature leather jacket, and treated like a celebrity around the world. He reportedly had 60 people reporting directly to him, as compared to the traditional five to seven for a CEO. As I wrote regarding Huang’s first reported affair, this mess leaves multiple large question marks hanging over global society. To be clear, I don’t buy the hero-founder myth; without a doubt, somebody at Nvidia or elsewhere could do the job just as well as he could. (Just don’t break the law or screw around on your spouse and you’re halfway there.) That said, the fact that so many people on Wall Street and among retail investors do believe the hero-founder myth could create a self-fulfilling prophecy. And concretely, Huang’s odd management style will mean either the new CEO will have to adapt to a highly unorthodox approach, or conduct a major organizational restructuring, which may disrupt the business. Oligarchs and Chinese Spies: Who’s the Bigger Threat to Americans? What’s more, something I neglected to cover in my first article is that Huang’s first affair may have been part of a straight-up conspiracy to smuggle huge numbers of Nvidia chips into China. His Chinese spy girlfriend Alice Huang ran a company called Megaspeed in Singapore, which some analysts allege is funded by Alibaba, the Chinese retail behemoth. It sure is very odd that Singapore should have suddenly started importing so many Nvidia chips that as of mid-2025, the city-state represented some 22 percent of the company’s total sales—which is roughly the same share that mega-nation China accounted for before export controls came down. After mid-2025, Nvidia simply stopped reporting that figure. Furthermore, investigations have found Megaspeed’s supposed corporate headquarters sit largely empty . Curious! Just as I was finishing this article, The Information reported that Alice Huang had invested in the Chinese AI company DeepSeek, promising them Nvidia chips. So in addition to general chaos and market panic unleashed by this scandal, it may cause a sharp decline in Nvidia’s sales, if not huge legal sanctions for violating American law. (Even Kash Patel’s FBI might be too embarrassed to avoid enforcing the law this time.) That will surely lead it to pull back from its investment in both AI labs and AI data center companies. If so, does that knock down the weaker, heavily indebted ones—like CoreWeave, Oracle, or OpenAI? What knock-on effects might that have on the financial companies that lent the money? That’s how a financial crisis gets rolling. Finally, there is the unfortunate question of Lori Huang. The couple met when they were broke teenage college students and have been married since 1985; they have two kids. If the Huangs get divorced and she gets half of the marital assets, she would instantly become roughly the 30th-richest person in the world , with a fortune in the $60-odd billion range at time of writing. That could turn out largely fine. MacKenzie Scott, Jeff Bezos’s ex-wife, turned out to become the rare mega-billionaire who actually gives money away to people who need it at a rapid clip , instead of to fake charitable foundations run by dim-witted relatives. (Even that, I would argue, is inferior to aid programs conducted by democratic governments.) The Prospect in your inbox Analysis that goes beyond the noise with in-depth, progressive reporting. Sign up No paywall, no programmatic ads — just the reporting. Unsubscribe anytime. Submitting your email signs you up for The Daily Prospect, our weekday morning newsletter. But it could also turn out to be a disaster. When Google co-founder Sergey Brin’s former wife Nicole Shanahan reportedly had a brief affair with Elon Musk (don’t ask me), she got about a billion dollars out of the ensuing divorce settlement in 2023. With that, Shanahan became one of the largest funders of the anti-vaccine movement, then one of the largest funders of Robert Kennedy Jr.’s presidential campaign in 2024, and then eventually his running mate. It is reasonably likely that without this funding—which included shouldering most of a $7 million Super Bowl ad—Kennedy would not be leading the Department of Health and Human Services today. I should emphasize that there is no indication that Lori Huang is a delirious crank. All the accounts I can find report she is a perfectly decent person. My point is that it is a disaster for society for anyone to have this much money, because the downside risk is just too great. Just one billion dollars was enough for one crank to hoist another crank into the most important public-health position in the world, where he slashed funding for cutting-edge medical research , fired world-class scientists en masse , and completely failed to control the worst measles outbreak in more than 30 years. This kind of thing can happen as an incidental consequence of apparently rampant cheating among the billionaire class—even with a prenuptial agreement; Shanahan got less than 1 percent of Brin’s fortune. Hyper-concentration of markets means that one man’s sexual indiscretions can become an entire planet’s economic problem. The concomitant hyper-concentration of wealth means that the ensuing divorce court details can have world-historic implications. Pennsylvania babies should not be dying because of some random oligarch affair, and if we taxed billionaire fortunes out of existence, they wouldn’t be. content:
规避出口管制：彭博社报道称，爱丽丝·黄（黄仁勋丑闻的中心女性，与黄仁勋有染，美国情报官员认为她是中国间谍）可能参与了走私人工智能芯片，这些芯片随后被安装在上海的一个数据中心。彭博社报道称，“据一位因讨论敏感话题而要求匿名的知情人士透露，部分服务器最初出售给总部位于新加坡的 Nvidia 官方云合作伙伴 Aperia Cloud Services。” “但文件显示，这些硬件并没有留在这个岛国，而是落入了爱丽丝在上海一家庞大的人工智能设施中创立的一家中国公司手中。该项目与爱丽丝有很多联系，包括她所擅长的 Megaspeed 在 2024 年的投资者演示中使用了数据中心的渲染图。”彭博社继续说道：“具体来说，Aperia 从戴尔科技公司购买了 22 台包含 Nvidia H800 芯片的服务器，华盛顿在 2023 年限制这些服务器向中国销售。彭博社向一位知情人士提供了这些服务器的序列号，该人士证实 Aperia 是戴尔的客户。”这似乎违反了美国的贸易限制。
特朗普政府声称将非常积极地确保美国制造的芯片（例如英伟达制造的芯片）最终不会为中国人工智能提供动力，但现实要复杂得多。有人说商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克对英伟达很宽容。据《纽约时报》报道，卢特尼克“经常就如何监管先进技术的销售，特别是英伟达对亚洲的芯片销售与高级官员发生冲突”。 “这引起了政府和国会其他人的指责，称商务部与英伟达及其联合创始人黄仁勋过于亲密，尤其未能充分监管该公司对中国的芯片销售。”英伟达显然与商务部关系非常融洽：“现任和前任官员表示，在商务部，英伟达的待遇与其他公司不同，其问题得到高度重视并通过特定渠道发送。卢特尼克先生经常与黄先生打电话发消息，商务部精心准备在卢特尼克先生五楼办公室举行的私人会议。英伟达的所有事务都通过卢特尼克先生的高级副手杰夫·凯斯勒处理，据说他很少采取任何重大行动英伟达的总法律顾问还有权直接制定新规则，包括在影响该公司的法规草案中发表评论。
英伟达总法律顾问蒂姆·泰特 (Tim Teter) 在商务部内因积极主动的外展活动而闻名。去年底，商务部内部关于 Megaspeed 是否向中国走私英伟达芯片的调查被叫停，并在泰特直接联系商务部调查人员并援引凯斯勒先生的名义进行调查后，转交给了司法部。它影响了与中国的人工智能竞赛。纽约场景：布鲁克林弗拉特布什的一座建筑随机倒塌，造成八人死亡“消防队员和护理人员涌入现场。消防员将尸体倒入坑中

【原文 English Original】
Skirting export controls: Bloomberg is reporting that Alice Huang—the woman at the center of the Jensen Huang scandal, with whom he had an affair and who is believed by U.S. intelligence officials to be a Chinese spy—possibly played a part in smuggling AI chips that were then installed at a data center in Shanghai. "Some of the servers were originally sold to Aperia Cloud Services, an official Nvidia Cloud Partner headquartered in Singapore, according to a person familiar with the matter, who requested anonymity to discuss a sensitive topic," reports Bloomberg. " But instead of staying in the island nation, the documents show, the hardware wound up in the hands of a Chinese company Alice founded, at a sprawling AI facility in Shanghai. That project has several ties to Alice, including that Megaspeed—which she was high up at—used a rendering of the data center in a 2024 investor presentation." "Specifically, Aperia purchased 22 servers from Dell Technologies Inc. that contained Nvidia's H800 chips," continues Bloomberg, "which Washington restricted from sale to China in 2023. Bloomberg provided serial numbers of those servers to a person familiar with the transaction, who confirmed that Aperia was Dell's customer." This appears to be in violation of U.S. trade restrictions. The Trump administration has claimed to be pretty aggressive with making sure U.S.-made chips, such as those manufactured by Nvidia, don't end up powering Chinese AI, but the reality is much more complicated. Some say Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick has gone easy on Nvidia. Lutnick "has frequently clashed with top officials over how to regulate sales of advanced technology, particularly Nvidia's chip sales to Asia," reports The New York Times. "That has drawn accusations from others in the administration and in Congress that the Commerce Department has become too cozy with Nvidia and its co-founder, Jensen Huang, and failed to adequately police the firm's chip sales to China, in particular." Nvidia has apparently been very cozy with the Commerce Department: "Within the Commerce Department, Nvidia is treated differently than other firms, current and former officials say, with its issues given high priority and sent through specific channels. Mr. Lutnick frequently calls and messages with Mr. Huang, and the department prepares carefully for their private meetings together in Mr. Lutnick's fifth floor office. All Nvidia matters are routed through Jeff Kessler, a top deputy to Mr. Lutnick, who is said to rarely take any significant action without the commerce secretary's approval. Nvidia's general counsel has also been given direct access to shape new rules, including leaving comments in draft regulations affecting the company. Nvidia's general counsel, Tim Teter, is known within the Commerce Department for his aggressive outreach. An inquiry inside the agency into whether Megaspeed was smuggling Nvidia chips into China was shut down late last year and transferred to the Justice Department after Mr. Teter reached out directly to Commerce Department investigators, invoking Mr. Kessler's name in doing so." It's likely more will come out regarding the Trump administration's willingness to look past issues with Jensen Huang—and the degree to which it's affected the AI race against China. Scenes from New York: A building in Flatbush, Brooklyn, randomly collapsed, leaving eight dead. "Firefighters and paramedics swarmed the scene. Firefighters poured into the pit where the excavation had been taking place, hauling aside brick and concrete in search of victims and survivors. Ambulances parked nearby, awaiting patients to deliver to hospitals. Soon, drones would hover over the scene—some operated by emergency workers, others by news crews," reported The New York Times. " A fire truck that had parked on Flatbush extended its long ladder directly into the apartments in the neighboring building that had been exposed to the open air — a jarring sight, like the cross-section of a dollhouse." QUICK HITS " Anthropic PBC 's initial public offering has drawn about six times the orders for the shares available, according to people familiar with the matter, as interest increases for potentially the biggest first-time share sale ever," reports Bloomberg. "Operators of small-town water stations locked out of control panels across the Midwest. Networks on two Texas-bound energy tankers breached as they crossed into the Atlantic Ocean. Hundreds of refrigerators in European grocery stores ratcheted up to a blistering 120 degrees Fahrenheit," reports The Wall Street Journal. " Three cyberattacks since this summer with real-world impacts and one main suspect: Iranian hackers." Was Supreme Court Justice Elena Kagan totally wrong? asks Charles Lane at The Washington Post. "Dutch Prime Minister Rob ​Jetten will try to save his minority government from collapse in a meeting with coalition ‌partners on Friday, after a heated debate over wealth taxes exposed deep divisions a day earlier," reports Reuters. "Jetten's three-party coalition threatened to fall apart less than 9 months after its installation , as parties bickered over a deal with the left-wing opposition to support a ​2027 tax plan in exchange for a slight increase of wealth taxes." The post The Chinese Connection appeared first on Reason Magazine .

summary: 白宫周五宣布，唐纳德·特朗普、弗拉基米尔·普京和习近平将于下周在深圳举行的峰会上举行美国、俄罗斯和中国领导人的首次三边会议。一位美国官员表示，特朗普希望在定于周四举行的这次会议上讨论削减核武库的问题，并将提出与伊朗的战争问题，但预计他不会讨论乌克兰战争。美国国会因与涉嫌中国间谍的关系而传唤英伟达前首席执行官 核武器和伊朗问题提上议程 三位领导人将在场外会面
content:
白宫周五宣布，唐纳德·特朗普、弗拉基米尔·普京和习近平将于下周在深圳举行的峰会上举行美国、俄罗斯和中国领导人的首次三边会议。一位美国官员表示，特朗普希望在定于周四举行的这次会议上讨论削减核武库的问题，并将提出与伊朗的战争问题，但预计他不会讨论乌克兰战争。白宫发言人奥利维亚·威尔士 (Olivia Wales) 表示，美国国会因与涉嫌中国间谍的关系而传唤英伟达前首席执行官 核武器和伊朗问题 三位领导人将在亚太经合组织 (APEC) 峰会期间会面，该峰会将于 11 月 18 日至 19 日在中国南方城市举行，由习近平主持。 “总统已明确表示，除其他问题外，他将讨论削减世界核武器库。总统认为这种扩散非常危险，”威尔士说。这位不愿透露姓名的官员在接受记者采访时表示，华盛顿预计不会达成协议，并将这次会议描述为切入点，也是三个国家领导层之间的首次对话。他补充说，中国核武库的增长速度比世界上任何其他国家都快，北京必须在谈判桌上发挥成熟的作用。
美国官员表示，主导特朗普第二任期的主要冲突之一将得到解决，但另一个不会得到解决。这位官员表示：“我认为总统确实打算在与习近平和普京的三边会议上讨论伊朗问题。”他补充说，关于乌克兰，华盛顿还有与基辅和莫斯科进行谈判的另一个途径，他指的是美国特使最近几天与普京和乌克兰总统泽伦斯基进行的对话。这位官员补充道：“中国实际上并不是这条道路的一部分，因此在那里解决乌克兰问题似乎并不合适。”唐纳德·特朗普 (Donald Trump) 提议蒂姆·库克 (Tim Cook) 接替黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 担任英伟达 (Nvidia) 核武器和伊朗业务负责人。特朗普将于周一离开华盛顿，周二抵达菲律宾参加东南亚国家联盟 (ASEAN) 峰会，然后前往深圳。他将在那里享用双边工作午餐并与中国国家主席会面，但他没有计划与普京进行面对面会晤。这次会议是在华盛顿和莫斯科之间的《新削减战略武器条约》于二月份到期之后举行的，特朗普拒绝延长该条约，并提议就一项包括北京在内的现代化条约进行谈判。官员们表示，特斯拉和 SpaceX 首席执行官埃隆·马斯克将陪同特朗普访华，但不会参加与习近平和普京的会面。 ]]>

【原文 English Original】
Donald Trump , Vladimir Putin y Xi Jinping sostendrán la primera reunión trilateral entre los líderes de Estados Unidos, Rusia y China en una cumbre en Shenzhen la próxima semana, anunció el viernes la Casa Blanca. Trump quiere conversar sobre la reducción del arsenal nuclear en esta reunión, prevista para el jueves, y planteará el tema de la guerra con Irán , pero no se espera que discuta la guerra en Ucrania, dijo un funcionario estadunidense. Congreso de EU cita a ex CEO de Nvidia por relación con presunta espía china Armas nucleares e Irán en la agenda Los tres líderes se reunirán al margen de la cumbre del Foro de Cooperación Económica Asia-Pacífico ( APEC ), que se celebra el 18 y 19 de noviembre en la ciudad del sur de China y que tiene a Xi como anfitrión, refirió la portavoz de la Casa Blanca, Olivia Wales. "El presidente ha dejado claro que, entre otros temas, discutirá la reducción del arsenal de armas nucleares en el mundo. El presidente cree que esta proliferación es muy peligrosa", dijo Wales. El funcionario, que habló bajo condición de anonimato en una llamada con periodistas, dijo que Washington no espera un acuerdo y describió la reunión como el punto de entrada y la primera conversación entre los tres países a nivel de líderes. Agregó que el arsenal nuclear de China crece más rápido que ningún otro del mundo y que Pekín debe asumir un papel de adulto en la mesa. Uno de los grandes conflictos que domina el segundo mandato de Trump será tratado, pero el otro no, dijeron funcionarios estadunidenses. "Creo que el presidente sí tiene intención de hablar sobre Irán en la reunión trilateral con Xi Jinping y Vladímir Putin", dijo el funcionario. Sobre Ucrania, Washington tiene otra vía de negociaciones con Kiev y Moscú, añadió, en referencia a las conversaciones que enviados estadunidenses han mantenido en los últimos días con Putin y el presidente ucraniano Volodímir Zelenski. "China no forma realmente parte de esa vía, así que no parece apropiado abordar allí la cuestión de Ucrania", agregó el funcionario. Donald Trump propone a Tim Cook para sustituir a Jensen Huang en la dirección de Nvidia Armas nucleares e Irán en la agenda Trump saldrá de Washington el lunes y llegará el martes a Filipinas para la cumbre de la Asociación de Naciones del Sudeste Asiático (Asean), antes de viajar a Shenzhen. Allí tendrá un almuerzo de trabajo bilateral y una reunión con el presidente chino, y no está previsto que mantenga una reunión cara a cara con Putin. La cita llega después de que en febrero expirara el tratado Nuevo START entre Washington y Moscú, y de que Trump rechazara prorrogarlo y planteara negociar uno modernizado que incluya a Pekín. El jefe de Tesla y SpaceX, Elon Musk , acompañará a Trump en su viaje a China, pero no participará en la reunión con Xi y Putin, señalaron los funcionarios. ]]>
